"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { WidgetFrame, WidgetControls } from "./frame";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Slider } from "@/components/ui/slider";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";
import { CartesianGrid, Line, LineChart, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis } from "recharts";
import { ArrowRight, Play, RotateCcw, TrendingDown } from "lucide-react";

/* ===================== math ===================== */
const sig = (z: number) => 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-z));

type Params = {
  x1: number;
  x2: number;
  target: number;
  eta: number;
  w: number[]; // w1..w6
  b: number[]; // b_h1, b_h2, b_o
};

const DEFAULTS: Params = {
  x1: 0.5,
  x2: 0.3,
  target: 1.0,
  eta: 0.5,
  w: [0.2, 0.4, 0.3, 0.1, 0.5, 0.6],
  b: [0.25, 0.2, 0.4],
};

function forward(p: Params) {
  const h1in = p.x1 * p.w[0] + p.x2 * p.w[1] + p.b[0];
  const h1out = sig(h1in);
  const h2in = p.x1 * p.w[2] + p.x2 * p.w[3] + p.b[1];
  const h2out = sig(h2in);
  const oin = h1out * p.w[4] + h2out * p.w[5] + p.b[2];
  const oout = sig(oin);
  const L = 0.5 * (p.target - oout) ** 2;
  return { h1in, h1out, h2in, h2out, oin, oout, L };
}

function backward(p: Params, f: ReturnType<typeof forward>) {
  const dL_doout = -(p.target - f.oout);
  const sigpO = f.oout * (1 - f.oout);
  const deltaO = dL_doout * sigpO;
  const gw = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
  gw[4] = deltaO * f.h1out;
  gw[5] = deltaO * f.h2out;
  const gbo = deltaO;
  const dL_dh1out = deltaO * p.w[4];
  const sigpH1 = f.h1out * (1 - f.h1out);
  const deltaH1 = dL_dh1out * sigpH1;
  gw[0] = deltaH1 * p.x1;
  gw[1] = deltaH1 * p.x2;
  const dL_dh2out = deltaO * p.w[5];
  const sigpH2 = f.h2out * (1 - f.h2out);
  const deltaH2 = dL_dh2out * sigpH2;
  gw[2] = deltaH2 * p.x1;
  gw[3] = deltaH2 * p.x2;
  return { dL_doout, sigpO, deltaO, gw, gbo, dL_dh1out, sigpH1, deltaH1, dL_dh2out, sigpH2, deltaH2 };
}

function updatedParams(p: Params, g: ReturnType<typeof backward>): Params {
  // notes update w1..w6 and b_o; hidden biases are left fixed
  return {
    ...p,
    w: p.w.map((v, i) => v - p.eta * g.gw[i]),
    b: [p.b[0], p.b[1], p.b[2] - p.eta * g.gbo],
  };
}

/* number formatting (guards against -0.0000) */
const fmt = (v: number, d = 4) => (Math.abs(v) < 0.5 * 10 ** -d ? 0 : v).toFixed(d);
const f2 = (v: number) => fmt(v, 2);
const f4 = (v: number) => fmt(v, 4);
const sgn = (v: number, d = 4) => (v >= 0 ? `+${fmt(v, d)}` : `−${fmt(-v, d)}`);

/* ===================== network diagram ===================== */
const NODES = {
  x1: { x: 58, y: 100 },
  x2: { x: 58, y: 208 },
  h1: { x: 218, y: 74 },
  h2: { x: 218, y: 218 },
  o: { x: 368, y: 146 },
  L: { x: 474, y: 146 },
};
const EDGES: { from: keyof typeof NODES; to: keyof typeof NODES; label: string; lx: number; ly: number; idx: number }[] = [
  { from: "x1", to: "h1", label: "w₁", lx: 132, ly: 78, idx: 0 },
  { from: "x2", to: "h1", label: "w₂", lx: 126, ly: 138, idx: 1 },
  { from: "x1", to: "h2", label: "w₃", lx: 126, ly: 174, idx: 2 },
  { from: "x2", to: "h2", label: "w₄", lx: 132, ly: 232, idx: 3 },
  { from: "h1", to: "o", label: "w₅", lx: 293, ly: 98, idx: 4 },
  { from: "h2", to: "o", label: "w₆", lx: 293, ly: 198, idx: 5 },
];

function NetworkDiagram({ step, p, f, g }: { step: number; p: Params; f: ReturnType<typeof forward>; g: ReturnType<typeof backward> }) {
  const flow = step === 1 ? "forward" : step === 2 || step === 3 ? "backward" : "updated";
  const isHighlighted = (idx: number) =>
    flow === "backward" ? (step === 2 ? idx >= 4 : idx <= 3) : true;

  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 520 320" className="mx-auto w-full max-w-xl" role="img">
      {/* edges */}
      {EDGES.map((e) => {
        const a = NODES[e.from];
        const b = NODES[e.to];
        const highlighted = isHighlighted(e.idx);
        const stroke =
          flow === "updated"
            ? "#10b981"
            : flow === "forward"
              ? "var(--primary)"
              : highlighted
                ? "#f97316"
                : undefined;
        const animated = flow === "forward" || (flow === "backward" && highlighted);
        return (
          <motion.line
            key={e.idx}
            x1={a.x}
            y1={a.y}
            x2={b.x}
            y2={b.y}
            stroke={stroke ?? "currentColor"}
            className={stroke ? undefined : "text-muted-foreground/50"}
            strokeWidth={highlighted || flow !== "backward" ? 3 : 2}
            strokeDasharray={animated ? "8 6" : undefined}
            initial={false}
            animate={animated ? { strokeDashoffset: flow === "forward" ? [0, -14] : [0, 14] } : { strokeDashoffset: 0 }}
            transition={animated ? { repeat: Infinity, duration: 0.7, ease: "linear" } : { duration: 0.2 }}
          />
        );
      })}
      {/* o -> L edge */}
      <motion.line
        x1={NODES.o.x + 26}
        y1={NODES.o.y}
        x2={NODES.L.x - 24}
        y2={NODES.L.y}
        stroke={flow === "backward" ? "#f97316" : "currentColor"}
        className={flow === "backward" ? undefined : "text-muted-foreground/50"}
        strokeWidth={2.5}
        strokeDasharray={flow === "backward" ? "8 6" : undefined}
        initial={false}
        animate={flow === "backward" ? { strokeDashoffset: [0, 14] } : { strokeDashoffset: 0 }}
        transition={flow === "backward" ? { repeat: Infinity, duration: 0.7, ease: "linear" } : { duration: 0.2 }}
      />

      {/* weight labels */}
      {EDGES.map((e) => (
        <text
          key={`wl${e.idx}`}
          x={e.lx}
          y={e.ly}
          textAnchor="middle"
          fontSize={12.5}
          fontWeight={700}
          className="fill-foreground stroke-background"
          strokeWidth={4}
          paintOrder="stroke"
        >
          {e.label}={f2(p.w[e.idx])}
        </text>
      ))}

      {/* bias labels */}
      <text x={NODES.h1.x} y={NODES.h1.y + 44} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} className="fill-muted-foreground" fontWeight={600}>
        bₕ₁={f2(p.b[0])}
      </text>
      <text x={NODES.h2.x} y={NODES.h2.y + 44} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} className="fill-muted-foreground" fontWeight={600}>
        bₕ₂={f2(p.b[1])}
      </text>
      <text x={NODES.o.x} y={NODES.o.y + 46} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} className="fill-muted-foreground" fontWeight={600}>
        b_o={f2(p.b[2])}
      </text>

      {/* nodes */}
      {(["x1", "x2"] as const).map((k, i) => (
        <g key={k}>
          <circle cx={NODES[k].x} cy={NODES[k].y} r={26} className="fill-background stroke-foreground/70" strokeWidth={2} />
          <text x={NODES[k].x} y={NODES[k].y - 2} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={14} fontWeight={700} className="fill-foreground">
            {k === "x1" ? "x₁" : "x₂"}
          </text>
          <text x={NODES[k].x} y={NODES[k].y + 13} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={9.5} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
            {f2(i === 0 ? p.x1 : p.x2)}
          </text>
        </g>
      ))}
      {(["h1", "h2"] as const).map((k) => {
        const isH1 = k === "h1";
        const active = step >= 1;
        const deltaActive = step >= 3;
        return (
          <g key={k}>
            <circle
              cx={NODES[k].x}
              cy={NODES[k].y}
              r={26}
              className={cn("fill-background", step === 3 ? "stroke-orange-500" : "stroke-foreground/70")}
              strokeWidth={step === 3 ? 3 : 2}
            />
            <text x={NODES[k].x} y={NODES[k].y - 2} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={13} fontWeight={700} className="fill-foreground">
              {isH1 ? "h₁" : "h₂"}
            </text>
            <text x={NODES[k].x} y={NODES[k].y + 12} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={9} className="fill-primary font-mono">
              {active ? (isH1 ? f4(f.h1out) : f4(f.h2out)) : "σ"}
            </text>
            <AnimatePresence>
              {deltaActive && (
                <motion.text
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                  x={NODES[k].x}
                  y={isH1 ? NODES[k].y - 36 : NODES[k].y - 36}
                  textAnchor="middle"
                  fontSize={10}
                  fontWeight={700}
                  className="fill-orange-500 font-mono"
                >
                  δ = {f4(isH1 ? g.deltaH1 : g.deltaH2)}
                </motion.text>
              )}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </g>
        );
      })}
      <g>
        <circle
          cx={NODES.o.x}
          cy={NODES.o.y}
          r={26}
          className={cn("fill-background", step === 2 ? "stroke-orange-500" : "stroke-foreground/70")}
          strokeWidth={step === 2 ? 3 : 2}
        />
        <text x={NODES.o.x} y={NODES.o.y - 2} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={14} fontWeight={700} className="fill-foreground">
          o
        </text>
        <text x={NODES.o.x} y={NODES.o.y + 12} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={9} className="fill-primary font-mono">
          {step >= 1 ? f4(f.oout) : "σ"}
        </text>
        <AnimatePresence>
          {step >= 2 && (
            <motion.text
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
              x={NODES.o.x}
              y={NODES.o.y - 36}
              textAnchor="middle"
              fontSize={10}
              fontWeight={700}
              className="fill-orange-500 font-mono"
            >
              δ_o = {f4(g.deltaO)}
            </motion.text>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </g>
      <g>
        <rect x={NODES.L.x - 24} y={NODES.L.y - 17} width={48} height={34} rx={9} className="fill-background stroke-foreground/70" strokeWidth={2} />
        <text x={NODES.L.x} y={NODES.L.y - 2} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={13} fontWeight={700} className="fill-foreground">
          L
        </text>
        <text x={NODES.L.x} y={NODES.L.y + 11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={9} className={cn("font-mono", step >= 1 ? "fill-destructive" : "fill-muted-foreground")}>
          {step >= 1 ? f4(f.L) : "loss"}
        </text>
      </g>

      {/* title chip */}
      <text x={260} y={20} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} fontWeight={600} className="fill-muted-foreground">
        2 - 2 - 1 network · all neurons sigmoid · L = ½(target − o)²
      </text>
    </svg>
  );
}

/* ===================== small building blocks ===================== */
function CalcLine({ formula, expr, result, tone }: { formula: string; expr: string; result: string; tone?: "strong" | "muted" }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 border-b border-border/60 py-1.5 last:border-0 sm:flex-row sm:items-baseline sm:gap-3">
      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground sm:min-w-[210px]">{formula}</span>
      <span className="flex-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-foreground/90">{expr}</span>
      <span className={cn("font-mono text-xs font-bold", tone === "strong" ? "text-primary" : tone === "muted" ? "text-muted-foreground" : "text-foreground")}>
        {result}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

function ParamSlider({
  label,
  value,
  min,
  max,
  step,
  onChange,
  disabled,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  step: number;
  onChange: (v: number) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/50 px-2.5 py-1.5">
      <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold">{label}</span>
        <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-primary">{f2(value)}</span>
      </div>
      <Slider
        value={[value]}
        min={min}
        max={max}
        step={step}
        disabled={disabled}
        onValueChange={(v) => onChange(v[0])}
        aria-label={label}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/* ===================== main ===================== */
export default function Component({ title, description }: { title?: string; description?: string }) {
  const [params, setParams] = useState<Params>(DEFAULTS);
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [training, setTraining] = useState(false);
  const isAuto = useRef(false);
  const trainTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  const f = useMemo(() => forward(params), [params]);
  const g = useMemo(() => backward(params, f), [params, f]);
  const pNew = useMemo(() => updatedParams(params, g), [params, g]);
  const fNew = useMemo(() => forward(pNew), [pNew]);

  const setManual = (patch: Partial<Params>) => {
    if (training) return;
    isAuto.current = false;
    setHistory([]);
    setParams((p) => ({ ...p, ...patch }));
  };
  const setW = (i: number, v: number) => setManual({ w: params.w.map((x, k) => (k === i ? v : x)) });
  const setB = (i: number, v: number) => setManual({ b: params.b.map((x, k) => (k === i ? v : x)) });

  const resetAll = () => {
    if (trainTimer.current) clearInterval(trainTimer.current);
    setTraining(false);
    isAuto.current = false;
    setParams(DEFAULTS);
    setHistory([]);
    setStep(1);
  };

  const train30 = () => {
    if (training) return;
    setTraining(true);
    isAuto.current = true;
    let p = params;
    let h = [forward(p).L];
    let epoch = 0;
    setHistory(h);
    trainTimer.current = setInterval(() => {
      epoch += 1;
      const grad = backward(p, forward(p));
      p = updatedParams(p, grad);
      h = [...h, forward(p).L];
      setParams(p);
      setHistory(h);
      if (epoch >= 30) {
        if (trainTimer.current) clearInterval(trainTimer.current);
        setTraining(false);
        isAuto.current = false;
      }
    }, 110);
  };

  useEffect(() => () => {
    if (trainTimer.current) clearInterval(trainTimer.current);
  }, []);

  const chartData = history.map((l, i) => ({ epoch: i, loss: l }));
  const steps = [
    { n: 1, label: "Forward pass" },
    { n: 2, label: "Output delta" },
    { n: 3, label: "Hidden deltas" },
    { n: 4, label: "Update & verify" },
  ];

  return (
    <WidgetFrame
      title={title ?? "Backpropagation Walkthrough — 2-2-1 Network"}
      description={
        description ??
        "The complete worked example: x₁ = 0.5, x₂ = 0.3, target = 1, η = 0.5. Walk through the forward pass, the backward chain rule, and the weight update — every number matches the notes. Change any parameter and everything recomputes live."
      }
      accent="u1"
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {/* diagram + params */}
        <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_290px]">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <NetworkDiagram step={step} p={params} f={f} g={g} />
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-[10.5px] text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="h-0.5 w-4 rounded bg-primary" /> forward (step 1)
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="h-0.5 w-4 rounded bg-orange-500" /> backward gradients (steps 2-3)
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="h-0.5 w-4 rounded bg-emerald-500" /> after update (step 4)
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* parameter panel */}
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold">Parameters</p>
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-7 px-2 text-[11px]" onClick={resetAll}>
                <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Reset
              </Button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">inputs &amp; training</p>
            <ParamSlider label="x₁" value={params.x1} min={0} max={1} step={0.05} onChange={(v) => setManual({ x1: v })} disabled={training} />
            <ParamSlider label="x₂" value={params.x2} min={0} max={1} step={0.05} onChange={(v) => setManual({ x2: v })} disabled={training} />
            <ParamSlider label="target" value={params.target} min={0} max={1} step={0.05} onChange={(v) => setManual({ target: v })} disabled={training} />
            <ParamSlider label="η (learning rate)" value={params.eta} min={0.05} max={1.5} step={0.05} onChange={(v) => setManual({ eta: v })} disabled={training} />
            <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">hidden layer</p>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
              <ParamSlider label="w₁" value={params.w[0]} min={-1} max={1} step={0.01} onChange={(v) => setW(0, v)} disabled={training} />
              <ParamSlider label="w₂" value={params.w[1]} min={-1} max={1} step={0.01} onChange={(v) => setW(1, v)} disabled={training} />
              <ParamSlider label="w₃" value={params.w[2]} min={-1} max={1} step={0.01} onChange={(v) => setW(2, v)} disabled={training} />
              <ParamSlider label="w₄" value={params.w[3]} min={-1} max={1} step={0.01} onChange={(v) => setW(3, v)} disabled={training} />
              <ParamSlider label="bₕ₁" value={params.b[0]} min={-1} max={1} step={0.01} onChange={(v) => setB(0, v)} disabled={training} />
              <ParamSlider label="bₕ₂" value={params.b[1]} min={-1} max={1} step={0.01} onChange={(v) => setB(1, v)} disabled={training} />
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">output layer</p>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
              <ParamSlider label="w₅" value={params.w[4]} min={-1} max={1} step={0.01} onChange={(v) => setW(4, v)} disabled={training} />
              <ParamSlider label="w₆" value={params.w[5]} min={-1} max={1} step={0.01} onChange={(v) => setW(5, v)} disabled={training} />
              <ParamSlider label="b_o" value={params.b[2]} min={-1} max={1} step={0.01} onChange={(v) => setB(2, v)} disabled={training} />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* step controller */}
        <WidgetControls>
          {steps.map((s) => (
            <Button key={s.n} size="sm" variant={step === s.n ? "default" : "outline"} onClick={() => setStep(s.n)}>
              <span className="font-mono">{s.n}</span> {s.label}
            </Button>
          ))}
          <Button size="sm" className="ml-auto" onClick={train30} disabled={training}>
            {training ? <TrendingDown className="h-4 w-4 animate-pulse" /> : <Play className="h-4 w-4" />}
            {training ? `training… ${history.length - 1}/30` : "Train 30 epochs"}
          </Button>
        </WidgetControls>

        {/* step panels */}
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
          <motion.div
            key={step}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -6 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
            className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3.5"
          >
            {step === 1 && (
              <div>
                <p className="mb-1.5 text-sm font-semibold">
                  Step 1 — Forward pass <span className="font-normal text-muted-foreground">(values flow left to right; every activation is stored for the backward pass)</span>
                </p>
                <CalcLine formula="h₁_in = x₁w₁ + x₂w₂ + bₕ₁" expr={`(${f2(params.x1)})(${f2(params.w[0])}) + (${f2(params.x2)})(${f2(params.w[1])}) + ${f2(params.b[0])}`} result={f4(f.h1in)} />
                <CalcLine formula="h₁_out = σ(h₁_in)" expr={`σ(${f4(f.h1in)})`} result={f4(f.h1out)} tone="strong" />
                <CalcLine formula="h₂_in = x₁w₃ + x₂w₄ + bₕ₂" expr={`(${f2(params.x1)})(${f2(params.w[2])}) + (${f2(params.x2)})(${f2(params.w[3])}) + ${f2(params.b[1])}`} result={f4(f.h2in)} />
                <CalcLine formula="h₂_out = σ(h₂_in)" expr={`σ(${f4(f.h2in)})`} result={f4(f.h2out)} tone="strong" />
                <CalcLine formula="o_in = h₁_out·w₅ + h₂_out·w₆ + b_o" expr={`(${f4(f.h1out)})(${f2(params.w[4])}) + (${f4(f.h2out)})(${f2(params.w[5])}) + ${f2(params.b[2])}`} result={f4(f.oin)} />
                <CalcLine formula="o_out = σ(o_in)" expr={`σ(${f4(f.oin)})`} result={f4(f.oout)} tone="strong" />
                <CalcLine formula="L = ½(target − o_out)²" expr={`½(${f4(params.target)} − ${f4(f.oout)})²`} result={f4(f.L)} tone="strong" />
              </div>
            )}

            {step === 2 && (
              <div>
                <p className="mb-1.5 text-sm font-semibold">
                  Step 2 — Backward pass: output layer <span className="font-normal text-muted-foreground">(chain rule: ∂L/∂w = ∂L/∂o_out · ∂o_out/∂o_in · ∂o_in/∂w)</span>
                </p>
                <CalcLine formula="∂L/∂o_out = −(target − o_out)" expr={`−(${f4(params.target)} − ${f4(f.oout)})`} result={f4(g.dL_doout)} />
                <CalcLine formula="∂o_out/∂o_in = o_out(1 − o_out)" expr={`${f4(f.oout)} × ${f4(1 - f.oout)}`} result={f4(g.sigpO)} />
                <CalcLine formula="δ_o = ∂L/∂o_in" expr={`(${f4(g.dL_doout)})(${f4(g.sigpO)})`} result={f4(g.deltaO)} tone="strong" />
                <CalcLine formula="∂L/∂w₅ = δ_o × h₁_out" expr={`(${f4(g.deltaO)})(${f4(f.h1out)})`} result={f4(g.gw[4])} />
                <CalcLine formula="∂L/∂w₆ = δ_o × h₂_out" expr={`(${f4(g.deltaO)})(${f4(f.h2out)})`} result={f4(g.gw[5])} />
                <CalcLine formula="∂L/∂b_o = δ_o × 1" expr={`(${f4(g.deltaO)})(1)`} result={f4(g.gbo)} />
                <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                  δ_o summarises how much the loss changes per unit change of the output neuron&apos;s
                  net input. It is computed once and reused for every weight feeding that neuron.
                </p>
              </div>
            )}

            {step === 3 && (
              <div>
                <p className="mb-1.5 text-sm font-semibold">
                  Step 3 — Backward pass: hidden layer <span className="font-normal text-muted-foreground">(the chain extends one link further: ∂L/∂h_out = δ_o × w)</span>
                </p>
                <CalcLine formula="∂L/∂h₁_out = δ_o × w₅" expr={`(${f4(g.deltaO)})(${f2(params.w[4])})`} result={f4(g.dL_dh1out)} />
                <CalcLine formula="h₁_out(1 − h₁_out)" expr={`${f4(f.h1out)} × ${f4(1 - f.h1out)}`} result={f4(g.sigpH1)} />
                <CalcLine formula="δ_h₁" expr={`(${f4(g.dL_dh1out)})(${f4(g.sigpH1)})`} result={f4(g.deltaH1)} tone="strong" />
                <CalcLine formula="∂L/∂w₁ = δ_h₁ × x₁" expr={`(${f4(g.deltaH1)})(${f2(params.x1)})`} result={f4(g.gw[0])} />
                <CalcLine formula="∂L/∂w₂ = δ_h₁ × x₂" expr={`(${f4(g.deltaH1)})(${f2(params.x2)})`} result={f4(g.gw[1])} />
                <CalcLine formula="∂L/∂h₂_out = δ_o × w₆" expr={`(${f4(g.deltaO)})(${f2(params.w[5])})`} result={f4(g.dL_dh2out)} />
                <CalcLine formula="h₂_out(1 − h₂_out)" expr={`${f4(f.h2out)} × ${f4(1 - f.h2out)}`} result={f4(g.sigpH2)} />
                <CalcLine formula="δ_h₂" expr={`(${f4(g.dL_dh2out)})(${f4(g.sigpH2)})`} result={f4(g.deltaH2)} tone="strong" />
                <CalcLine formula="∂L/∂w₃ = δ_h₂ × x₁" expr={`(${f4(g.deltaH2)})(${f2(params.x1)})`} result={f4(g.gw[2])} />
                <CalcLine formula="∂L/∂w₄ = δ_h₂ × x₂" expr={`(${f4(g.deltaH2)})(${f2(params.x2)})`} result={f4(g.gw[3])} />
                <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                  Notice δ_o is reused (multiplied by w₅ or w₆), not recomputed — this layer-by-layer
                  reuse of deltas is exactly what makes backpropagation efficient.
                </p>
              </div>
            )}

            {step === 4 && (
              <div>
                <p className="mb-1.5 text-sm font-semibold">
                  Step 4 — Weight update <span className="font-mono font-normal text-muted-foreground">w ← w − η·∂L/∂w, η = {f2(params.eta)}</span>
                </p>
                <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[430px] text-xs">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="border-b bg-muted/50 text-left text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                        <th className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium">parameter</th>
                        <th className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium">old</th>
                        <th className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium">gradient</th>
                        <th className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium">update</th>
                        <th className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium">new</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="font-mono">
                      {[
                        { name: "w₁", old: params.w[0], gr: g.gw[0], nw: pNew.w[0] },
                        { name: "w₂", old: params.w[1], gr: g.gw[1], nw: pNew.w[1] },
                        { name: "w₃", old: params.w[2], gr: g.gw[2], nw: pNew.w[2] },
                        { name: "w₄", old: params.w[3], gr: g.gw[3], nw: pNew.w[3] },
                        { name: "w₅", old: params.w[4], gr: g.gw[4], nw: pNew.w[4] },
                        { name: "w₆", old: params.w[5], gr: g.gw[5], nw: pNew.w[5] },
                        { name: "b_o", old: params.b[2], gr: g.gbo, nw: pNew.b[2] },
                      ].map((r) => (
                        <tr key={r.name} className="border-b last:border-0">
                          <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-semibold">{r.name}</td>
                          <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5">{f4(r.old)}</td>
                          <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5">{f4(r.gr)}</td>
                          <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-muted-foreground">
                            {f4(r.old)} {sgn(-params.eta * r.gr)}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-bold text-primary">{f4(r.nw)}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>

                {/* verification */}
                <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <CalcLine formula="verify: new o_out" expr={`forward pass with updated weights`} result={f4(fNew.oout)} />
                </div>
                <div className="mt-1">
                  <CalcLine formula="verify: new loss" expr={`½(${f4(params.target)} − ${f4(fNew.oout)})²`} result={f4(fNew.L)} tone="strong" />
                </div>
                {fNew.L < f.L ? (
                  <motion.p
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.97 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                    className="mt-2.5 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-emerald-300/60 bg-emerald-500/10 p-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
                  >
                    <TrendingDown className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                    Loss decreased: {f4(f.L)} → {f4(fNew.L)} after one step — the gradients pointed
                    downhill. (Hidden biases bₕ₁, bₕ₂ stay fixed, as in the notes&apos; example.)
                  </motion.p>
                ) : (
                  <p className="mt-2.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-300/60 bg-amber-500/10 p-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
                    With these settings the loss did not decrease ({f4(f.L)} → {f4(fNew.L)}) — try a
                    smaller η.
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        </AnimatePresence>

        {/* training chart */}
        {chartData.length > 1 && (
          <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
            <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold">
                <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Training loss over {history.length - 1} epoch
                {history.length - 1 === 1 ? "" : "s"} (repeated forward + backward + update)
              </p>
              <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                {f4(history[0])} → {f4(history[history.length - 1])}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="h-44 w-full">
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <LineChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 5, right: 10, bottom: 0, left: 0 }}>
                  <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="currentColor" className="text-muted-foreground/20" />
                  <XAxis dataKey="epoch" tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} stroke="currentColor" className="text-muted-foreground" tickLine={false} />
                  <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} stroke="currentColor" className="text-muted-foreground" tickLine={false} domain={["auto", "auto"]} width={54} tickFormatter={(v: number) => v.toFixed(4)} />
                  <Tooltip
                    formatter={(v: number | string) => [Number(v).toFixed(5), "loss"]}
                    labelFormatter={(l) => `epoch ${l}`}
                    contentStyle={{ fontSize: 11, borderRadius: 8 }}
                  />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="loss" stroke="var(--primary)" strokeWidth={2.5} dot={false} isAnimationActive={false} />
                </LineChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </WidgetFrame>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { WidgetFrame, WidgetControls, PlayButton, Stat } from "./frame";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Slider } from "@/components/ui/slider";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { AlertTriangle, StepForward, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";

/* ================= (a) learning rate on a 1-D bowl ================= */
/* f(w) = 0.6(w-4)^2 + 0.5, f'(w) = 1.2(w-4). eta = 1.9 makes |1 - eta*f''| = 1.28 > 1 -> divergence. */
const FW = (w: number) => 0.6 * (w - 4) ** 2 + 0.5;
const DFW = (w: number) => 1.2 * (w - 4);

const LR_W = 380;
const LR_H = 260;
const LR_PAD = { l: 40, r: 14, t: 16, b: 34 };
const LR_DOM = { wmin: -6, wmax: 10, ymin: 0, ymax: 12 };
const lpx = (w: number) => LR_PAD.l + ((w - LR_DOM.wmin) / (LR_DOM.wmax - LR_DOM.wmin)) * (LR_W - LR_PAD.l - LR_PAD.r);
const lpy = (v: number) => LR_PAD.t + ((LR_DOM.ymax - v) / (LR_DOM.ymax - LR_DOM.ymin)) * (LR_H - LR_PAD.t - LR_PAD.b);

const LR_PRESETS = [
  { eta: 0.1, label: "0.1 · slow" },
  { eta: 0.9, label: "0.9 · good" },
  { eta: 1.9, label: "1.9 · diverges" },
];

function LearningRateTab() {
  const [eta, setEta] = useState(0.9);
  const [w, setW] = useState(0);
  const [trail, setTrail] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [diverged, setDiverged] = useState(false);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  const step = () => {
    if (diverged) return;
    const wn = w - eta * DFW(w);
    setTrail((t) => [...t, w]);
    setW(wn);
    if (Math.abs(wn) > 12) {
      setDiverged(true);
      setPlaying(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return;
    timer.current = setInterval(step, 600);
    return () => {
      if (timer.current) clearInterval(timer.current);
    };
  }, [playing, w, eta, diverged]);

  const reset = () => {
    setPlaying(false);
    setW(0);
    setTrail([]);
    setDiverged(false);
  };

  const setEtaAndReset = (e: number) => {
    setPlaying(false);
    setEta(e);
    setW(0);
    setTrail([]);
    setDiverged(false);
  };

  // visual clamps
  const bx = Math.max(LR_DOM.wmin, Math.min(LR_DOM.wmax, w));
  const by = Math.max(LR_DOM.ymin + 0.15, Math.min(LR_DOM.ymax, FW(w)));
  const offChart = w < LR_DOM.wmin || w > LR_DOM.wmax;

  // curve path
  const curve: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= 160; i++) {
    const ww = LR_DOM.wmin + (i / 160) * (LR_DOM.wmax - LR_DOM.wmin);
    curve.push(`${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${lpx(ww).toFixed(1)},${lpy(FW(ww)).toFixed(1)}`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 pt-1 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,380px)_1fr]">
      <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[380px]">
        <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${LR_W} ${LR_H}`} className="w-full" role="img">
          <defs>
            <clipPath id="lrClip">
              <rect x={LR_PAD.l} y={LR_PAD.t} width={LR_W - LR_PAD.l - LR_PAD.r} height={LR_H - LR_PAD.t - LR_PAD.b} />
            </clipPath>
          </defs>
          <rect x={LR_PAD.l} y={LR_PAD.t} width={LR_W - LR_PAD.l - LR_PAD.r} height={LR_H - LR_PAD.t - LR_PAD.b} fill="currentColor" className="text-muted/30" />
          {/* grid */}
          {[-6, -4, -2, 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10].map((v) => (
            <g key={`gx${v}`}>
              <line x1={lpx(v)} y1={lpy(LR_DOM.ymin)} x2={lpx(v)} y2={lpy(LR_DOM.ymax)} stroke="currentColor" className="text-muted-foreground/25" strokeWidth={1} />
              <text x={lpx(v)} y={LR_H - LR_PAD.b + 14} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={9.5} className="fill-muted-foreground">
                {v}
              </text>
            </g>
          ))}
          {[0, 4, 8, 12].map((v) => (
            <g key={`gy${v}`}>
              <line x1={lpx(LR_DOM.wmin)} y1={lpy(v)} x2={lpx(LR_DOM.wmax)} y2={lpy(v)} stroke="currentColor" className="text-muted-foreground/25" strokeWidth={1} />
              <text x={LR_PAD.l - 5} y={lpy(v) + 3} textAnchor="end" fontSize={9.5} className="fill-muted-foreground">
                {v}
              </text>
            </g>
          ))}
          <text x={LR_W / 2} y={LR_H - 4} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} className="fill-muted-foreground font-medium">
            w
          </text>
          <text x={11} y={LR_H / 2} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} className="fill-muted-foreground font-medium" transform={`rotate(-90 11 ${LR_H / 2})`}>
            f(w)
          </text>

          {/* loss curve */}
          <path d={curve.join(" ")} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" className="text-primary" strokeWidth={2.5} clipPath="url(#lrClip)" />

          {/* minimum marker */}
          <g>
            <line x1={lpx(4)} y1={lpy(0.5)} x2={lpx(4)} y2={lpy(LR_DOM.ymax)} stroke="currentColor" className="text-muted-foreground/40" strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="3 3" />
            <circle cx={lpx(4)} cy={lpy(0.5)} r={4} fill="#10b981" />
            <text x={lpx(4) + 8} y={lpy(0.5) + 3} fontSize={9.5} className="fill-emerald-600 dark:fill-emerald-400" fontWeight={600}>
              minimum w* = 4
            </text>
          </g>

          {/* trail */}
          {trail.map((tw, i) => {
            const tx = Math.max(LR_DOM.wmin, Math.min(LR_DOM.wmax, tw));
            const ty = Math.max(LR_DOM.ymin + 0.15, Math.min(LR_DOM.ymax, FW(tw)));
            return <circle key={i} cx={lpx(tx)} cy={lpy(ty)} r={3} fill="#f97316" opacity={0.25 + (0.55 * (i + 1)) / Math.max(trail.length, 1)} />;
          })}

          {/* tangent at current w */}
          {!diverged && (
            <line
              x1={lpx(bx - 1.1)}
              y1={lpy(FW(bx) - DFW(bx) * -1.1)}
              x2={lpx(bx + 1.1)}
              y2={lpy(FW(bx) + DFW(bx) * 1.1)}
              stroke="#f59e0b"
              strokeWidth={2}
              clipPath="url(#lrClip)"
            />
          )}

          {/* ball */}
          <motion.g animate={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}>
            <motion.circle
              animate={{ cx: lpx(bx), cy: lpy(by) }}
              transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 130, damping: 17 }}
              cx={lpx(bx)}
              cy={lpy(by)}
              r={8}
              fill={diverged ? "#ef4444" : "#f97316"}
              stroke="currentColor"
              className="stroke-background"
              strokeWidth={2}
            />
          </motion.g>
          {offChart && (
            <text x={LR_W / 2} y={LR_PAD.t + 14} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={10.5} fontWeight={700} className="fill-red-500">
              w = {w.toFixed(2)} — off the chart!
            </text>
          )}
        </svg>
        <p className="mt-1 text-center font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          f(w) = 0.6(w − 4)² + 0.5 · update: w ← w − η·f′(w)
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <WidgetControls>
          {LR_PRESETS.map((p) => (
            <Button
              key={p.eta}
              size="sm"
              variant={eta === p.eta ? "default" : "outline"}
              onClick={() => setEtaAndReset(p.eta)}
            >
              η = {p.label}
            </Button>
          ))}
        </WidgetControls>

        <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/50 px-3 py-2.5">
          <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-medium">learning rate η</span>
            <span className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-primary">{eta.toFixed(2)}</span>
          </div>
          <Slider
            value={[eta]}
            min={0.05}
            max={2.5}
            step={0.05}
            onValueChange={(v) => setEtaAndReset(v[0])}
            aria-label="learning rate"
          />
        </div>

        <WidgetControls>
          <PlayButton onClick={() => !diverged && setPlaying((p) => !p)} playing={playing} label="Run" />
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={step} disabled={diverged}>
            <StepForward className="h-4 w-4" /> Step
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={reset}>
            <RotateCcw className="h-4 w-4" /> Reset
          </Button>
        </WidgetControls>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
          <Stat label="w" value={w.toFixed(3)} />
          <Stat label="f(w)" value={FW(w).toFixed(3)} />
          <Stat label="f′(w)" value={DFW(w).toFixed(3)} />
          <Stat label="steps" value={trail.length} />
        </div>

        {diverged ? (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-300/60 bg-red-500/10 p-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold leading-relaxed text-red-600 dark:text-red-400"
          >
            <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
            Diverged! |w| &gt; 12 — with η = {eta.toFixed(2)} each step overshoots the minimum by more
            than the last step undershot, so the iterate oscillates outward instead of settling.
            Reset and try η = 0.9.
          </motion.div>
        ) : (
          <p className="rounded-lg bg-muted/50 p-2.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            The gradient (orange tangent) always points uphill; the update steps the opposite way.
            Too small an η crawls toward the minimum; around η ≈ 0.9 it lands almost instantly; too
            large and it overshoots, oscillates, and diverges.
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ================= (b) batch vs SGD on linear regression ================= */
const REG_PTS = [
  { x: 1, y: 3 },
  { x: 2, y: 5 },
  { x: 3, y: 7 },
];

const RG_W = 380;
const RG_H = 280;
const RG_PAD = { l: 38, r: 14, t: 14, b: 32 };
const RG_DOM = { xmin: 0, xmax: 4, ymin: 0, ymax: 8 };
const rpx = (x: number) => RG_PAD.l + ((x - RG_DOM.xmin) / (RG_DOM.xmax - RG_DOM.xmin)) * (RG_W - RG_PAD.l - RG_PAD.r);
const rpy = (y: number) => RG_PAD.t + ((RG_DOM.ymax - y) / (RG_DOM.ymax - RG_DOM.ymin)) * (RG_H - RG_PAD.t - RG_PAD.b);

function BatchSgdTab() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"batch" | "sgd">("batch");
  const [w, setW] = useState(1);
  const [b, setB] = useState(0.5);
  const [sgdIdx, setSgdIdx] = useState(0); // next SGD point index
  const [updates, setUpdates] = useState(0);
  const [whist, setWhist] = useState<number[]>([1]);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  const epoch = mode === "batch" ? updates : Math.floor(updates / 3);
  const preds = REG_PTS.map((p) => w * p.x + b);
  const errs = preds.map((yh, i) => yh - REG_PTS[i].y);
  const loss = (errs.reduce((s, e) => s + e * e, 0)) / 3;

  const doStep = () => {
    if (mode === "batch") {
      const gw = (2 / 3) * errs.reduce((s, e, i) => s + e * REG_PTS[i].x, 0);
      const gb = (2 / 3) * errs.reduce((s, e) => s + e, 0);
      setW((v) => v - 0.1 * gw);
      setB((v) => v - 0.1 * gb);
      setUpdates((u) => u + 1);
      setWhist((h) => [...h, w - 0.1 * gw]);
    } else {
      const i = sgdIdx;
      const gw = 2 * errs[i] * REG_PTS[i].x;
      const gb = 2 * errs[i];
      const nw = w - 0.1 * gw;
      const nb = b - 0.1 * gb;
      setW(nw);
      setB(nb);
      setSgdIdx((v) => (v + 1) % 3);
      setUpdates((u) => u + 1);
      setWhist((h) => [...h.slice(-5), nw]);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return;
    timer.current = setInterval(doStep, 750);
    return () => {
      if (timer.current) clearInterval(timer.current);
    };
  }, [playing, w, b, sgdIdx, mode]);

  const reset = (m: "batch" | "sgd") => {
    setPlaying(false);
    setMode(m);
    setW(1);
    setB(0.5);
    setSgdIdx(0);
    setUpdates(0);
    setWhist([1]);
  };

  const yAt = (x: number) => w * x + b;

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 pt-1 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,380px)_1fr]">
      <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[380px]">
        <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${RG_W} ${RG_H}`} className="w-full" role="img">
          <defs>
            <clipPath id="rgClip">
              <rect x={RG_PAD.l} y={RG_PAD.t} width={RG_W - RG_PAD.l - RG_PAD.r} height={RG_H - RG_PAD.t - RG_PAD.b} />
            </clipPath>
          </defs>
          <rect x={RG_PAD.l} y={RG_PAD.t} width={RG_W - RG_PAD.l - RG_PAD.r} height={RG_H - RG_PAD.t - RG_PAD.b} fill="currentColor" className="text-muted/30" />
          {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((v) => (
            <g key={`gx${v}`}>
              <line x1={rpx(v)} y1={rpy(RG_DOM.ymin)} x2={rpx(v)} y2={rpy(RG_DOM.ymax)} stroke="currentColor" className="text-muted-foreground/25" strokeWidth={1} />
              <text x={rpx(v)} y={RG_H - RG_PAD.b + 14} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={10} className="fill-muted-foreground">
                {v}
              </text>
            </g>
          ))}
          {[0, 2, 4, 6, 8].map((v) => (
            <g key={`gy${v}`}>
              <line x1={rpx(RG_DOM.xmin)} y1={rpy(v)} x2={rpx(RG_DOM.xmax)} y2={rpy(v)} stroke="currentColor" className="text-muted-foreground/25" strokeWidth={1} />
              <text x={RG_PAD.l - 5} y={rpy(v) + 3} textAnchor="end" fontSize={10} className="fill-muted-foreground">
                {v}
              </text>
            </g>
          ))}
          <text x={RG_W / 2} y={RG_H - 4} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} className="fill-muted-foreground font-medium">
            x
          </text>
          <text x={11} y={RG_H / 2} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} className="fill-muted-foreground font-medium" transform={`rotate(-90 11 ${RG_H / 2})`}>
            y
          </text>

          {/* fitted line (clipped + animated) */}
          <motion.line
            x1={rpx(RG_DOM.xmin)}
            y1={rpy(yAt(RG_DOM.xmin))}
            x2={rpx(RG_DOM.xmax)}
            y2={rpy(yAt(RG_DOM.xmax))}
            animate={{
              y1: rpy(yAt(RG_DOM.xmin)),
              y2: rpy(yAt(RG_DOM.xmax)),
            }}
            transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 110, damping: 18 }}
            stroke="currentColor"
            className="text-primary"
            strokeWidth={2.5}
            clipPath="url(#rgClip)"
          />
          {/* true relationship y = 2x + 1 (dashed) */}
          <line
            x1={rpx(0)}
            y1={rpy(1)}
            x2={rpx(4)}
            y2={rpy(9)}
            stroke="#10b981"
            strokeWidth={1.5}
            strokeDasharray="5 4"
            opacity={0.7}
            clipPath="url(#rgClip)"
          />

          {/* data points */}
          {REG_PTS.map((p, i) => {
            const active = mode === "sgd" && i === sgdIdx;
            return (
              <g key={i}>
                {active && <circle cx={rpx(p.x)} cy={rpy(p.y)} r={13} fill="#f97316" opacity={0.25} />}
                <circle cx={rpx(p.x)} cy={rpy(p.y)} r={7} fill={active ? "#f97316" : "#0ea5e9"} stroke="currentColor" className="stroke-background" strokeWidth={1.5} />
                <text x={rpx(p.x) + 10} y={rpy(p.y) - 8} fontSize={9.5} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
                  ({p.x},{p.y})
                </text>
              </g>
            );
          })}
        </svg>
        <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-sky-500" /> data point
          </span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="h-0.5 w-4 bg-primary" /> current fit ŷ = wx + b
          </span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="h-0.5 w-4 bg-emerald-500" /> true line y = 2x + 1
          </span>
          {mode === "sgd" && (
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-orange-500" /> current sample
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <WidgetControls>
          <Button size="sm" variant={mode === "batch" ? "default" : "outline"} onClick={() => reset("batch")}>
            Batch GD
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant={mode === "sgd" ? "default" : "outline"} onClick={() => reset("sgd")}>
            SGD (one point at a time)
          </Button>
          <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">η = 0.1</span>
        </WidgetControls>

        <WidgetControls>
          <PlayButton onClick={() => setPlaying((p) => !p)} playing={playing} label="Run" />
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={doStep}>
            <StepForward className="h-4 w-4" /> Step
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => reset(mode)}>
            <RotateCcw className="h-4 w-4" /> Reset
          </Button>
        </WidgetControls>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
          <Stat label="w" value={w.toFixed(4)} />
          <Stat label="b" value={b.toFixed(4)} />
          <Stat label="epoch" value={epoch} />
          <Stat label="loss (1/3)Σ(ŷ−y)²" value={loss.toFixed(4)} tone={loss < 0.01 ? "good" : "default"} />
        </div>

        {/* per-point table */}
        <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border">
          <table className="w-full text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b bg-muted/50 text-left text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                <th className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium">x</th>
                <th className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium">y</th>
                <th className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium">ŷ = wx + b</th>
                <th className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium">error ŷ−y</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="font-mono">
              {REG_PTS.map((p, i) => {
                const active = mode === "sgd" && i === sgdIdx;
                return (
                  <tr key={i} className={cn("border-b last:border-0", active && "bg-orange-500/10 font-semibold")}>
                    <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5">{p.x}</td>
                    <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5">{p.y}</td>
                    <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5">{w.toFixed(2)}({p.x}) + {b.toFixed(2)} = {preds[i].toFixed(2)}</td>
                    <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5">{errs[i].toFixed(2)}</td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {/* gradient formulas */}
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-3 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
          {mode === "batch" ? (
            <>
              <p className="mb-1 font-semibold text-foreground">Batch — one update per epoch, using all 3 points:</p>
              <p>∂L/∂w = (2/n)Σ(ŷᵢ−yᵢ)·xᵢ = (2/3)({errs.map((e, i) => `(${e.toFixed(2)})(${REG_PTS[i].x})`).join("+")})</p>
              <p>∂L/∂b = (2/n)Σ(ŷᵢ−yᵢ) = (2/3)({errs.map((e) => `(${e.toFixed(2)})`).join("+")})</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-foreground">first step: w 1.0 → 2.1333, b 0.5 → 1.0 (the notes&apos; numbers)</p>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <p className="mb-1 font-semibold text-foreground">SGD — 3 updates per epoch, one point each (highlighted):</p>
              <p>∂L/∂w = 2(ŷ−y)·x on the chosen point · ∂L/∂b = 2(ŷ−y)</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-foreground">
                w path: {whist.map((v) => v.toFixed(2)).join(" → ")}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-muted-foreground">
                first step (point (1,3)): w 1.0 → 1.3, b 0.5 → 0.8 — smaller steps, but 3x cheaper
                per epoch.
              </p>
            </>
          )}
        </div>

        <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
          {mode === "batch"
            ? "Batch GD uses the combined signal of all points, so each update is exact and the path is smooth — but one epoch costs a full pass over the data."
            : "SGD zig-zags: each update is computed from a single point, so it is noisy but very cheap. Despite the noise it usually reaches a good solution faster in wall-clock time, and the noise can even help escape shallow local minima."}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ================= main ================= */
export default function Component({ title, description }: { title?: string; description?: string }) {
  return (
    <WidgetFrame
      title={title ?? "Gradient Descent Playground"}
      description={
        description ??
        "w ← w − η·∂L/∂w. Part 1: feel how the learning rate decides between crawling, converging, and exploding. Part 2: compare Batch GD (all points per update) with SGD (one point per update) on the notes' linear regression example."
      }
      accent="u1"
    >
      <Tabs defaultValue="lr">
        <TabsList className="w-full sm:w-auto">
          <TabsTrigger value="lr">Learning rate</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="sgd">Batch vs SGD</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>
        <TabsContent value="lr">
          <LearningRateTab />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="sgd">
          <BatchSgdTab />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </WidgetFrame>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { WidgetFrame, WidgetControls } from "./frame";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { CheckCircle2, Crosshair, Dices, Eraser, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";

/* ---------------- shared plotting helpers ---------------- */
type Pt = { x: number; y: number; name?: string };
const DOM = { xmin: 0, xmax: 8, ymin: 0, ymax: 6 };
const PAD = { l: 38, r: 14, t: 14, b: 32 };
const W = 360;
const H = 280;
const sx = (x: number) => PAD.l + ((x - DOM.xmin) / (DOM.xmax - DOM.xmin)) * (W - PAD.l - PAD.r);
const sy = (y: number) => PAD.t + ((DOM.ymax - y) / (DOM.ymax - DOM.ymin)) * (H - PAD.t - PAD.b);

const CLUSTER_COLORS = ["#0ea5e9", "#f43f5e", "#f59e0b", "#8b5cf6"];
const dist = (a: Pt, b: Pt) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
const f2 = (v: number) => v.toFixed(2);

function nearest(p: Pt, centroids: Pt[]) {
  let best = 0;
  let bd = Infinity;
  centroids.forEach((c, i) => {
    const d = dist(p, c);
    if (d < bd - 1e-12) {
      bd = d;
      best = i;
    }
  });
  return best;
}

function means(pts: Pt[], assign: number[], k: number, old: Pt[]): Pt[] {
  const out: Pt[] = [];
  for (let c = 0; c < k; c++) {
    const mine = pts.filter((_, i) => assign[i] === c);
    if (mine.length === 0) {
      out.push(old[c] ?? { x: NaN, y: NaN }); // empty cluster keeps its position
    } else {
      out.push({
        x: mine.reduce((s, p) => s + p.x, 0) / mine.length,
        y: mine.reduce((s, p) => s + p.y, 0) / mine.length,
      });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/* ---------------- the shared plot ---------------- */
function KMeansPlot({
  points,
  centroids,
  assign,
  onAdd,
}: {
  points: Pt[];
  centroids: Pt[];
  assign: (number | null)[];
  onAdd?: (p: Pt) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
      className={cn("w-full", onAdd && "cursor-crosshair")}
      role="img"
      onClick={
        onAdd
          ? (e) => {
              const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
              const px = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * W;
              const py = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * H;
              const x = DOM.xmin + ((px - PAD.l) / (W - PAD.l - PAD.r)) * (DOM.xmax - DOM.xmin);
              const y = DOM.ymax - ((py - PAD.t) / (H - PAD.t - PAD.b)) * (DOM.ymax - DOM.ymin);
              if (x >= DOM.xmin && x <= DOM.xmax && y >= DOM.ymin && y <= DOM.ymax) onAdd({ x, y });
            }
          : undefined
      }
    >
      <rect x={PAD.l} y={PAD.t} width={W - PAD.l - PAD.r} height={H - PAD.t - PAD.b} fill="currentColor" className="text-muted/30" />
      {/* grid + ticks */}
      {Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => i).map((v) => (
        <g key={`gx${v}`}>
          <line x1={sx(v)} y1={sy(DOM.ymin)} x2={sx(v)} y2={sy(DOM.ymax)} stroke="currentColor" className="text-muted-foreground/25" strokeWidth={1} />
          {v % 2 === 0 && (
            <text x={sx(v)} y={H - PAD.b + 14} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={10} className="fill-muted-foreground">
              {v}
            </text>
          )}
        </g>
      ))}
      {Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => i).map((v) => (
        <g key={`gy${v}`}>
          <line x1={sx(DOM.xmin)} y1={sy(v)} x2={sx(DOM.xmax)} y2={sy(v)} stroke="currentColor" className="text-muted-foreground/25" strokeWidth={1} />
          {v % 2 === 0 && (
            <text x={PAD.l - 6} y={sy(v) + 3} textAnchor="end" fontSize={10} className="fill-muted-foreground">
              {v}
            </text>
          )}
        </g>
      ))}
      <text x={W / 2} y={H - 4} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} className="fill-muted-foreground font-medium">x</text>
      <text x={11} y={H / 2} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} className="fill-muted-foreground font-medium" transform={`rotate(-90 11 ${H / 2})`}>y</text>

      {/* lines from assigned points to their centroid */}
      {assign.map((a, i) =>
        a !== null && centroids[a] && !isNaN(centroids[a].x) ? (
          <line
            key={`ln${i}`}
            x1={sx(points[i].x)}
            y1={sy(points[i].y)}
            x2={sx(centroids[a].x)}
            y2={sy(centroids[a].y)}
            stroke={CLUSTER_COLORS[a]}
            strokeWidth={1.2}
            opacity={0.45}
            strokeDasharray="4 3"
          />
        ) : null
      )}

      {/* points */}
      {points.map((p, i) => {
        const a = assign[i];
        const col = a === null ? "#9ca3af" : CLUSTER_COLORS[a];
        return (
          <g key={`pt${i}`}>
            <circle cx={sx(p.x)} cy={sy(p.y)} r={7} fill={col} opacity={a === null ? 0.55 : 0.9} stroke="currentColor" className="text-background" strokeWidth={1.5} />
            {p.name && (
              <text x={sx(p.x) + 10} y={sy(p.y) - 8} fontSize={10.5} fontWeight={600} className="fill-foreground">
                {p.name}
              </text>
            )}
          </g>
        );
      })}

      {/* centroids (animated with a CSS transform transition) */}
      {centroids.map((c, i) =>
        isNaN(c.x) ? null : (
          <g
            key={`ce${i}`}
            style={{
              transform: `translate(${sx(c.x)}px, ${sy(c.y)}px)`,
              transition: "transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)",
            }}
          >
            <line x1={-8} y1={-8} x2={8} y2={8} stroke={CLUSTER_COLORS[i]} strokeWidth={3.5} strokeLinecap="round" />
            <line x1={-8} y1={8} x2={8} y2={-8} stroke={CLUSTER_COLORS[i]} strokeWidth={3.5} strokeLinecap="round" />
            <circle r={11} fill="none" stroke={CLUSTER_COLORS[i]} strokeWidth={1} opacity={0.4} />
          </g>
        )
      )}
    </svg>
  );
}

function CentroidLegend({ k }: { k: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
      {Array.from({ length: k }, (_, i) => (
        <span key={i} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full" style={{ background: CLUSTER_COLORS[i] }} />
          cluster {i + 1}
        </span>
      ))}
      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 14 14" className="h-3.5 w-3.5">
          <line x1={2} y1={2} x2={12} y2={12} stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2.5} strokeLinecap="round" />
          <line x1={2} y1={12} x2={12} y2={2} stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2.5} strokeLinecap="round" />
        </svg>
        centroid
      </span>
      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-gray-400" /> unassigned
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------- K-Means engine hook (shared by both modes) ---------------- */
function useKMeans(initialPoints: Pt[], initialCentroids: Pt[]) {
  const [points, setPoints] = useState<Pt[]>(initialPoints);
  const [centroids, setCentroids] = useState<Pt[]>(initialCentroids);
  const [assign, setAssign] = useState<(number | null)[]>(initialPoints.map(() => null));
  const [step, setStep] = useState<"start" | "assigned" | "updated">("start");
  const [iteration, setIteration] = useState(0);
  const [converged, setConverged] = useState(false);
  const [lastAssign, setLastAssign] = useState<(number | null)[] | null>(null);

  const canAssign = !converged && step !== "assigned";
  const canUpdate = !converged && step === "assigned";

  const doAssign = () => {
    const a = points.map((p) => nearest(p, centroids));
    setAssign(a);
    if (lastAssign && a.length === lastAssign.length && a.every((v, i) => v === lastAssign[i])) {
      setConverged(true);
      return;
    }
    setLastAssign(a);
    setStep("assigned");
  };

  const doUpdate = () => {
    const m = means(points, assign as number[], centroids.length, centroids);
    setCentroids(m);
    setIteration((v) => v + 1);
    setStep("updated");
  };

  const reset = (pts: Pt[], cents: Pt[]) => {
    setPoints(pts);
    setCentroids(cents);
    setAssign(pts.map(() => null));
    setIteration(0);
    setConverged(false);
    setLastAssign(null);
    setStep("start");
  };

  const reseed = (cents: Pt[]) => {
    setCentroids(cents);
    setAssign(points.map(() => null));
    setIteration(0);
    setConverged(false);
    setLastAssign(null);
    setStep("start");
  };

  return {
    points, centroids, assign, iteration, converged, canAssign, canUpdate,
    doAssign, doUpdate, reset, reseed,
    setPoints: (pts: Pt[]) => {
      setPoints(pts);
      setAssign((a) => pts.map((_, i) => a[i] ?? null));
      setConverged(false);
      setStep("start");
    },
  };
}

/* ---------------- main component ---------------- */
export default function Component({ title, description }: { title?: string; description?: string }) {
  return (
    <WidgetFrame
      title={title ?? "K-Means Clustering Lab"}
      description={
        description ??
        "K-Means groups unlabelled points by repeating two steps: assign every point to its nearest centroid, then move each centroid to the mean of its assigned points. Step through the notes' example, or play freely."
      }
      accent="u1"
    >
      <Tabs defaultValue="notes">
        <TabsList className="w-full sm:w-auto">
          <TabsTrigger value="notes">Notes example</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="free">Free play</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        {/* ================= (a) notes example ================= */}
        <TabsContent value="notes">
          <NotesMode />
        </TabsContent>

        {/* ================= (b) free play ================= */}
        <TabsContent value="free">
          <FreeMode />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </WidgetFrame>
  );
}

function NotesMode() {
  const NOTES_POINTS: Pt[] = [
    { x: 1, y: 1, name: "A" },
    { x: 2, y: 1, name: "B" },
    { x: 4, y: 3, name: "C" },
    { x: 5, y: 4, name: "D" },
  ];
  const NOTES_CENTS: Pt[] = [
    { x: 1, y: 1 },
    { x: 5, y: 4 },
  ];
  const km = useKMeans(NOTES_POINTS, NOTES_CENTS);
  const showAssignHint = km.assign.every((a) => a === null);

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 pt-1 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,360px)_1fr]">
      <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[360px]">
        <KMeansPlot points={km.points} centroids={km.centroids} assign={km.assign} />
        <CentroidLegend k={km.centroids.length} />
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <WidgetControls>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={km.doAssign} disabled={!km.canAssign}>
            1. Assign step
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={km.doUpdate} disabled={!km.canUpdate}>
            2. Update step
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => km.reset(NOTES_POINTS, NOTES_CENTS)}
            className="ml-auto"
          >
            <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" /> Reset
          </Button>
        </WidgetControls>

        <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-foreground">iteration {km.iteration}</span>
          <span className="mx-2">·</span>
          initial centroids C₁ = (1, 1), C₂ = (5, 4) — chosen as the first / last point
        </div>

        {km.converged ? (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl border border-emerald-300/60 bg-emerald-500/10 p-3 text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
          >
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
            Converged — assignments no longer change, so the centroids stop moving. Final centroids:
            C₁ = (1.50, 1.00), C₂ = (4.50, 3.50). No labels were used at any point.
          </motion.div>
        ) : showAssignHint ? (
          <p className="rounded-lg bg-muted/50 p-2.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            Step 1 — compute the Euclidean distance of every point to both centroids and assign it to
            the nearer one.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <p className="rounded-lg bg-muted/50 p-2.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            Step 2 — recompute each centroid as the mean of its assigned points. The centroids will
            move toward the centre of mass of their clusters.
          </p>
        )}

        {/* distance table */}
        <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border">
          <table className="w-full text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b bg-muted/50 text-left text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                <th className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium">point</th>
                <th className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium">d(C₁)</th>
                <th className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium">d(C₂)</th>
                <th className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium">cluster</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="font-mono">
              {km.points.map((p, i) => {
                const a = km.assign[i];
                return (
                  <tr key={p.name} className="border-b last:border-0">
                    <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5">
                      {p.name} ({p.x}, {p.y})
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5">{f2(dist(p, km.centroids[0]))}</td>
                    <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5">{f2(dist(p, km.centroids[1]))}</td>
                    <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5">
                      {a === null ? (
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">—</span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="font-semibold" style={{ color: CLUSTER_COLORS[a] }}>
                          cluster {a + 1}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        <p className="font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          C₁ = ({km.centroids[0].x.toFixed(2)}, {km.centroids[0].y.toFixed(2)}) · C₂ = (
          {km.centroids[1].x.toFixed(2)}, {km.centroids[1].y.toFixed(2)})
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function FreeMode() {
  const START_POINTS: Pt[] = [
    { x: 1.2, y: 4.6 },
    { x: 1.8, y: 4.0 },
    { x: 2.6, y: 4.9 },
    { x: 5.2, y: 1.4 },
    { x: 5.9, y: 2.0 },
    { x: 4.6, y: 2.4 },
    { x: 3.9, y: 4.4 },
  ];
  const km = useKMeans(START_POINTS, START_POINTS.slice(0, 2));
  const [k, setK] = useState(2);

  const applyK = (newK: number) => {
    setK(newK);
    if (km.points.length >= newK) {
      const cents = km.points.slice(0, newK).map((p) => ({ x: p.x, y: p.y }));
      km.reset(km.points, cents);
    }
  };

  const randomInit = () => {
    if (km.points.length < k) return;
    const shuffled = [...km.points].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
    km.reset(
      km.points,
      shuffled.slice(0, k).map((p) => ({ x: p.x, y: p.y }))
    );
  };

  const clusterCounts = useMemo(() => {
    const counts = new Array(k).fill(0);
    km.assign.forEach((a) => {
      if (a !== null) counts[a]++;
    });
    return counts;
  }, [km.assign, k]);

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 pt-1 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,360px)_1fr]">
      <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[360px]">
        <KMeansPlot
          points={km.points}
          centroids={km.centroids}
          assign={km.assign}
          onAdd={(p) => {
            const pts = [...km.points, p];
            km.setPoints(pts);
          }}
        />
        <CentroidLegend k={k} />
        <p className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-center text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          <Crosshair className="h-3 w-3" /> click the plot to add a point
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <WidgetControls>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={km.doAssign} disabled={!km.canAssign || km.points.length < k || km.centroids.length < k}>
            1. Assign step
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={km.doUpdate} disabled={!km.canUpdate}>
            2. Update step
          </Button>
        </WidgetControls>

        <WidgetControls>
          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">k =</span>
          {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((v) => (
            <Button
              key={v}
              size="sm"
              variant={k === v ? "default" : "outline"}
              className="h-8 w-8 p-0"
              onClick={() => applyK(v)}
              disabled={km.points.length < v}
            >
              {v}
            </Button>
          ))}
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={randomInit} disabled={km.points.length < k}>
            <Dices className="h-4 w-4" /> Random init
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => {
              km.reset(START_POINTS, START_POINTS.slice(0, k));
            }}
          >
            <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" /> Reset
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="ghost"
            onClick={() => {
              setK(2);
              km.reset([], []);
            }}
          >
            <Eraser className="h-4 w-4" /> Clear
          </Button>
        </WidgetControls>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
          <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 px-3 py-2">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">points</p>
            <p className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold">{km.points.length}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 px-3 py-2">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">iteration</p>
            <p className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold">{km.iteration}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 px-3 py-2">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">centroids</p>
            <p className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold">{km.centroids.length}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 px-3 py-2">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">cluster sizes</p>
            <p className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold">
              {clusterCounts.every((c) => c === 0) ? "—" : clusterCounts.join(" / ")}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {km.converged ? (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl border border-emerald-300/60 bg-emerald-500/10 p-3 text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
          >
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
            Converged after {km.iteration} full iteration{km.iteration === 1 ? "" : "s"} — try
            Random init to see how the starting centroids change the final clusters.
          </motion.div>
        ) : (
          <p className="rounded-lg bg-muted/50 p-2.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            Alternate the two steps: <strong>assign</strong> colours each point by its nearest
            centroid (Euclidean distance), <strong>update</strong> moves each centroid to the mean of
            its cluster. K-Means repeats until nothing changes — all without any target labels
            (unsupervised learning).
          </p>
        )}

        <p className="font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          centroids: {km.centroids.map((c) => `(${c.x.toFixed(2)}, ${c.y.toFixed(2)})`).join("  ·  ") || "—"}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
