          <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 22 6" className="h-1.5 w-6">
                <line x1={1} y1={2} x2={21} y2={2} stroke={C.h1} strokeWidth={1.3} />
                <line x1={1} y1={5} x2={21} y2={5} stroke={C.h1} strokeWidth={1.3} />
              </svg>
              all connections undirected
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono text-[10px]" style={{ color: C.up }}>
              ↑ bottom-up
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono text-[10px]" style={{ color: C.down }}>
              ↓ top-down
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1.5 rounded-lg bg-u4/10 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            bidirectional: top layers refine what lower layers think they saw
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* mean-field update */}
      <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3.5">
        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
          <Sigma className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-u4" /> Mean-field inference in a DBM
        </p>
        <p className="mt-2 break-words font-mono text-sm text-foreground">
          μ¹<sub>j</sub> ← σ( <span className="rounded bg-emerald-500/15 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">Σᵢ vᵢ W¹ᵢⱼ</span> +{" "}
          <span className="rounded bg-violet-500/15 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-semibold text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-400">Σₖ μ²ₖ W²ⱼₖ</span> )
        </p>
        <div className="mt-2 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5 p-2.5">
            <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">input term (bottom-up)</p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
              Evidence from the layer below — the same sigmoid rule a single RBM uses for P(h=1|v).
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-violet-500/30 bg-violet-500/5 p-2.5">
            <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-400">
              top-down term — the signature a DBN does NOT have
            </p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
              What the layer above currently believes, flowing back down through the undirected W².
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
          In a DBM, h¹ is sandwiched between v and h²: once v is observed, h¹ and h² become statistically dependent
          (&ldquo;explaining away&rdquo;), so the exact posterior would need summing over exponentially many hidden
          configurations. Mean-field variational inference approximates it with a factorised Q(h¹,h²) = ∏ᵢ q(h¹ᵢ)·∏ₖ
          q(h²ₖ) and iterates these fixed-point updates until convergence — each unit combining evidence from{" "}
          <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">both</span> neighbouring layers.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* comparison table + energy example */}
      <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_340px]">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[520px] border-collapse text-left">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b bg-muted/40">
                <th className="px-3 py-2.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Aspect</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-u4">Deep Belief Network (DBN)</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-u4">Deep Boltzmann Machine (DBM)</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {DBN_DBM_ROWS.map((r) => (
                <tr key={r.aspect} className="group/row border-b transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-muted/30">
                  <td className="px-3 py-2.5 align-top text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground group-hover/row:text-foreground">
                    {r.aspect}
                  </td>
                  <td className="border-l px-3 py-2.5 align-top text-xs leading-relaxed text-foreground/90">{r.dbn}</td>
                  <td className="border-l px-3 py-2.5 align-top text-xs leading-relaxed text-foreground/90">{r.dbm}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {/* Worked Example 7.1 */}
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3.5">
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
            <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-u4" /> Worked Example 7.1 — adding a layer lowers the energy
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            Extend Example 6.1 (v=[1,1], h¹=[1], W¹=[0.4,0.6]ᵀ, a=[0.1,0.2], b¹=0.3 → E = −1.6) with a second hidden
            unit on top.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-2.5 space-y-1 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            <p>
              1. v–h¹ part unchanged: <span className="text-foreground">{f2(E_RBM)}</span>
            </p>
            <p>
              2. −h¹ᵀW²h² = −(1×{f2(w2)}×{h2v}) = <span className="text-foreground">{f4(eInt)}</span>
            </p>
            <p>
              3. −b²ᵀh² = −({f2(b2)}×{h2v}) = <span className="text-foreground">{f4(eBias)}</span>
            </p>
            <p>
              4. E<sub>DBM</sub> = {f2(E_RBM)} + ({f4(eInt)}) + ({f4(eBias)}) ={" "}
              <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{f4(E)}</span>
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2.5 space-y-1">
            <SliderRow label="W²" value={w2} min={-1} max={1} step={0.05} onChange={setW2} />
            <SliderRow label="b²" value={b2} min={-0.5} max={0.5} step={0.05} onChange={setB2} />
            <div className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">h² = 1 (second layer on)</span>
              <Switch checked={h2on} onCheckedChange={setH2on} aria-label="toggle second hidden unit" />
            </div>
          </div>
          {/* energy comparison bars */}
          <div className="mt-1 space-y-1.5">
            {[
              { label: "RBM (1 layer)", e: E_RBM },
              { label: "DBM (2 layers)", e: E },
            ].map((row) => (
              <div key={row.label} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="w-24 shrink-0 font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{row.label}</span>
                <div className="h-4 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded bg-muted/70">
                  <motion.div
                    className={cn("h-full rounded", row.e < E_RBM - 0.001 ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-amber-500")}
                    initial={false}
                    animate={{ width: `${energyW(row.e)}%` }}
                    transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 120, damping: 20 }}
                  />
                </div>
                <span className="w-14 shrink-0 text-right font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold">{f4(row.e)}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <Stat label="E (RBM part)" value={f2(E_RBM)} />
            <Stat label="E (DBM total)" value={f4(E)} tone={E < E_RBM ? "good" : "bad"} />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5 p-2.5">
            <Lightbulb className="mt-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
              a compatible second layer further LOWERS the energy → deepens the model&rsquo;s belief (raises the
              probability of this joint configuration). This is exactly how deeper layers refine and reinforce the
              model&rsquo;s belief about the input.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ================================================================== */
/* Small slider row (shared by tabs)                                   */
/* ================================================================== */

function SliderRow({
  label,
  value,
  min,
  max,
  step = 0.01,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  step?: number;
  onChange: (v: number) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-3">
      <span className="w-24 shrink-0 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
      <Slider value={[value]} min={min} max={max} step={step} onValueChange={(v) => onChange(v[0])} className="h-11 flex-1" aria-label={label} />
      <span className="w-14 shrink-0 text-right font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">{f2(value)}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ================================================================== */
/* TAB 2 — Convolutional BM                                            */
/* ================================================================== */

const DEF_V = [
  [1, 0, 1],
  [1, 1, 0],
  [0, 1, 1],
];
const DEF_K = [
  [1, 0],
  [0, 1],
];
const POS: [number, number][] = [
  [0, 0],
  [0, 1],
  [1, 0],
  [1, 1],
];

function ConvTab() {
  const [v, setV] = useState<number[][]>(DEF_V.map((r) => [...r]));
  const [K, setK] = useState<number[][]>(DEF_K.map((r) => [...r]));
  const [b, setB] = useState(-1.5);
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0); // number of swept positions (0..4)
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);

  /* detection layer (K * v), stride 1, no padding — computed live */
  const conv = useMemo(() => {
    const out: number[][] = [
      [0, 0],
      [0, 0],
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++)
      for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
        let s = 0;
        for (let m = 0; m < 2; m++) for (let n = 0; n < 2; n++) s += K[m][n] * v[i + m][j + n];
        out[i][j] = s;
      }
    return out;
  }, [v, K]);

  const probs = useMemo(() => conv.map((row) => row.map((x) => sig(x + b))), [conv, b]);
  const poolP = useMemo(() => 1 - probs.flat().reduce((p, c) => p * (1 - c), 1), [probs]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return;
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      setStep((s) => {
        if (s >= 4) {
          setPlaying(false);
          return s;
        }
        return s + 1;
      });
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [playing]);

  const sweepDone = step >= 4;
  const patchIdx = Math.min(step, 3); // patch the filter is currently on
  const compIdx = step === 0 ? 0 : step - 1; // position whose computation is shown
  const isPreview = compIdx >= step; // step 0: showing the upcoming computation
  const [pi, pj] = POS[patchIdx];

  /* per-position computation string, e.g. "v(0,0) + v(1,1) = 1 + 1 = 2" */
  const ci = POS[compIdx][0];
  const cj = POS[compIdx][1];
  const compParts: string[] = [];
  const compVals: string[] = [];
  for (let m = 0; m < 2; m++)
    for (let n = 0; n < 2; n++)
      if (K[m][n] === 1) {
        compParts.push(`v(${ci + m},${cj + n})`);
        compVals.push(`${v[ci + m][cj + n]}`);
      }
  const compText =
    compParts.length === 0
      ? `out(${ci},${cj}) = 0  (filter is all zeros)`
      : `out(${ci},${cj}) = ${compParts.join(" + ")} = ${compVals.join(" + ")} = ${conv[ci][cj]}`;

  const toggleV = (i: number, j: number) => setV((old) => old.map((row, r) => (r === i ? row.map((x, c) => (c === j ? 1 - x : x)) : row)));
  const toggleK = (i: number, j: number) => setK((old) => old.map((row, r) => (r === i ? row.map((x, c) => (c === j ? 1 - x : x)) : row)));

  /* parameter comparison (Example 8.2) */
  const FC_PARAMS = 784 * 100;
  const CONV_PARAMS = 10 * (5 * 5);
  const RATIO = FC_PARAMS / CONV_PARAMS;
  const logW = (x: number) => (Math.log10(x) / Math.log10(FC_PARAMS)) * 100;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <WidgetControls>
        <PlayButton onClick={() => setPlaying((p) => !p)} playing={playing} label="Play" />
        <button
          onClick={() => setStep((s) => Math.min(4, s + 1))}
          disabled={step >= 4}
          className="min-h-11 rounded-lg border bg-background px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-muted disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          Step
        </button>
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          className="min-h-11 px-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground"
          onClick={() => {
            setV(DEF_V.map((r) => [...r]));
            setK(DEF_K.map((r) => [...r]));
            setB(-1.5);
            setStep(0);
            setPlaying(false);
          }}
        >
          <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Reset to notes values
        </Button>
        <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          sweep {step} / 4 · stride 1 · no padding → (3−2+1)×(3−2+1) = 2×2
        </span>
      </WidgetControls>

      {/* grids */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-center gap-4 lg:gap-6">
        {/* input */}
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
            Input v (3×3, click to toggle)
          </p>
          <div className="relative mx-auto mt-2 aspect-square w-full max-w-[216px]">
            <div className="grid h-full grid-cols-3 grid-rows-3 gap-1.5">
              {v.map((row, i) =>
                row.map((x, j) => (
                  <button
                    key={`${i}-${j}`}
                    onClick={() => toggleV(i, j)}
                    aria-label={`toggle v(${i},${j})`}
                    className={cn(
                      "flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border font-mono text-sm font-semibold transition-colors",
                      x === 1 ? "border-sky-500/60 bg-sky-500/25 text-foreground" : "border-border bg-muted/40 text-muted-foreground"
                    )}
                  >
                    {x}
                  </button>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
            {/* sliding 2×2 patch highlight */}
            <motion.div
              className="pointer-events-none absolute rounded-lg border-2 border-u4 shadow-sm"
              style={{ width: "64.5%", height: "64.5%" }}
              initial={false}
              animate={{ left: `${(pj * 100) / 3 + 1.2}%`, top: `${(pi * 100) / 3 + 1.2}%` }}
              transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 200, damping: 24 }}
            >
              <span className="absolute -top-5 left-0 rounded bg-u4 px-1 font-mono text-[9px] font-bold text-white">
                K at ({pi},{pj})
              </span>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 self-center pt-6 text-muted-foreground">
          <span className="font-mono text-[10px]">shared K, b</span>
          <ChevronRight className="h-5 w-5" />
        </div>

        {/* filter + bias */}
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
            Shared filter K (2×2, click to toggle)
          </p>
          <div className="mx-auto mt-2 grid w-full max-w-[128px] grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
            {K.map((row, i) =>
              row.map((x, j) => (
                <button
                  key={`${i}-${j}`}
                  onClick={() => toggleK(i, j)}
                  aria-label={`toggle K(${i},${j})`}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex aspect-square items-center justify-center rounded-lg border font-mono text-sm font-semibold transition-colors",
                    x === 1 ? "border-violet-500/60 bg-violet-500/25 text-foreground" : "border-border bg-muted/40 text-muted-foreground"
                  )}
                >
                  {x}
                </button>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 w-full max-w-[176px]">
            <SliderRow label="bias b" value={b} min={-3} max={3} step={0.1} onChange={setB} />
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            ONE shared bias — not one per position: P(hᵢⱼ=1|v) = σ((K∗v)ᵢⱼ + b)
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 self-center pt-6 text-muted-foreground">
          <span className="font-mono text-[10px]">slide</span>
          <ChevronRight className="h-5 w-5" />
        </div>

        {/* detection + probability */}
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Detection layer (K∗v)</p>
          <div className="mx-auto mt-2 grid w-full max-w-[128px] grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
            {POS.map(([i, j], idx) => (
              <div
                key={`${i}-${j}`}
                className={cn(
                  "flex aspect-square items-center justify-center rounded-lg border font-mono text-sm font-semibold transition-colors",
                  idx < step ? "border-primary/50 bg-primary/10 text-foreground" : "border-dashed border-border bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground/50"
                )}
              >
                {idx < step ? conv[i][j] : "·"}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <p className={cn("mt-2 font-mono text-[10px] leading-relaxed", isPreview ? "text-muted-foreground/70" : "text-muted-foreground")}>
            {isPreview ? "next: " : ""}
            {compText}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 self-center pt-6 text-muted-foreground">
          <span className="font-mono text-[10px]">σ(·+b)</span>
          <ChevronRight className="h-5 w-5" />
        </div>

        {/* firing probabilities */}
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
            Firing probabilities P = σ((K∗v)+b)
          </p>
          <div className="mx-auto mt-2 grid w-full max-w-[128px] grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
            {POS.map(([i, j]) => (
              <div
                key={`${i}-${j}`}
                className="flex aspect-square items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-border font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-foreground"
                style={{ backgroundColor: sweepDone ? `rgba(16, 185, 129, ${0.07 + 0.6 * probs[i][j]})` : undefined }}
              >
                {sweepDone ? f4(probs[i][j]) : "·"}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <p className="mt-2 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            {sweepDone ? "heat = probability of firing" : "finish the sweep (Play) to reveal probabilities"}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* interpretation */}
      <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 p-3">
        <Lightbulb className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-primary" />
        <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
          positions (0,0), (1,0), (1,1) all scored 2 — the SAME diagonal pattern [1,·;·,1] detected at every location ={" "}
          <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">translation invariance</span>. Position (0,1) had a mismatched
          patch and scored 0, giving a low firing probability. Because K and b do not depend on (i,j), the same small
          parameter set is reused everywhere — which is also what gives the huge parameter reduction below.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* probabilistic max-pooling */}
      <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3.5">
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
            <Grid3x3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-u4" /> Probabilistic max-pooling — why deterministic max breaks the model
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            Ordinary CNN max-pooling just takes max(·) deterministically — it has no probabilistic interpretation and
            cannot be plugged into an energy function. Probabilistic max-pooling instead groups a small block (2×2) of
            detection units {"{h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄}"} with one pooling unit p, and defines a <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">softmax-style
            joint over exactly 5 states</span> — one of the four h&rsquo;s ON with p=1, or all OFF with p=0:
          </p>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {["h₁=1, p=1", "h₂=1, p=1", "h₃=1, p=1", "h₄=1, p=1", "all h=0, p=0"].map((s) => (
              <span key={s} className="rounded-full border bg-background px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-foreground/90">
                {s}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
          <p className="mt-2 font-mono text-xs text-foreground">P(p=1 | v) = 1 − P(all hᵢ = 0 | v)</p>
          <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            (p fires if ANY unit in its block fires)
          </p>
          {sweepDone && (
            <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="mt-2 space-y-2">
              <p className="font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                with the current firing probabilities: 1 − (1−{f4(probs[0][0])})(1−{f4(probs[0][1])})(1−{f4(probs[1][0])})(1−
                {f4(probs[1][1])}) = <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{f4(poolP)}</span>
              </p>
              <Stat label="P(p=1 | v) — pooling unit fires" value={f4(poolP)} tone="accent" />
            </motion.div>
          )}
          <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            This keeps the whole architecture a proper probabilistic (Boltzmann) model with a well-defined energy
            function, while still achieving the same practical effect as CNN pooling: a smaller, spatially-invariant
            summary of each region.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* parameter comparison */}
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3.5">
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
            <Info className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-u4" /> Parameter efficiency — weight sharing vs fully-connected (Example 8.2)
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            A fully-connected RBM with 100 hidden units on a 28×28 image connects every visible unit to every hidden
            unit. A convolutional RBM uses 10 filters of size 5×5, shared across all positions.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
            <div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">Fully-connected RBM</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-xs">
                  784 × 100 = <span className="font-semibold">{FC_PARAMS.toLocaleString("en-US")}</span>{" "}
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">weights</span>
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1 h-6 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-muted/70">
                <motion.div className="h-full rounded-lg bg-rose-500/80" initial={{ width: 0 }} animate={{ width: `${logW(FC_PARAMS)}%` }} transition={{ duration: 0.9, ease: "easeOut" }} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">Convolutional RBM</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-xs">
                  10 × (5×5) = <span className="font-semibold">{CONV_PARAMS}</span>{" "}
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">weights (+10 shared biases)</span>
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1 h-6 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-muted/70">
                <motion.div className="h-full rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/80" initial={{ width: 0 }} animate={{ width: `${logW(CONV_PARAMS)}%` }} transition={{ duration: 0.9, ease: "easeOut", delay: 0.15 }} />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
              ≈{f1(RATIO)}× fewer parameters
            </span>
            <span className="rounded-full bg-muted px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">log₁₀-scaled bars</span>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            Over 300× fewer parameters for a comparable — indeed typically richer, since the convolution applies at every
            position — feature-detection capacity. This is the core practical reason convolutional variants scale to
            real images while fully-connected RBM / DBM / DBN do not.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* pipeline note */}
      <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
        <ArrowRight className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-u4" />
        <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
          Full pipeline: shared filter K slides over v (detection layer, this animation) → sigmoid with one shared bias
          gives firing probabilities → probabilistic max-pooling shrinks each feature map while keeping the model a
          valid Boltzmann machine. Stack detection + pooling layers to build a convolutional deep belief network —
          unsupervised hierarchical feature learning (edges → motifs → object parts), exactly like a CNN but without
          labels.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { WidgetFrame, Stat, WidgetControls } from "./frame";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { Slider } from "@/components/ui/slider";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { BarChart3, Waves, CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";

/* ---------------- helpers ---------------- */

const f2 = (x: number) => {
  const s = x.toFixed(2);
  return s === "-0.00" ? "0.00" : s;
};
const f4 = (x: number) => {
  const s = x.toFixed(4);
  return s === "-0.0000" ? "0.0000" : s;
};

const LOG2_3 = Math.log2(3); // 1.5850

function numEntropy(pdfF: (x: number) => number, lo: number, hi: number, n = 2400): number {
  const dx = (hi - lo) / n;
  let h = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
    const w = i === 0 || i === n ? 0.5 : 1;
    const p = pdfF(lo + i * dx);
    if (p > 1e-12) h += w * p * Math.log(p) * dx;
  }
  return -h;
}

function SliderRow({
  label,
  value,
  min,
  max,
  step = 0.01,
  onChange,
  accent,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  step?: number;
  onChange: (v: number) => void;
  accent?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-3">
      <span className="w-24 shrink-0 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
      <Slider value={[value]} min={min} max={max} step={step} onValueChange={(v) => onChange(v[0])} className="h-11 flex-1" aria-label={label} />
      <span className="w-14 shrink-0 text-right font-mono text-xs font-semibold" style={{ color: accent }}>
        {f2(value)}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

/* TAB A — Discrete maximum entropy (notes Example 5.1)               */
/* ================================================================== */

function DiscreteTab() {
  const [p1, setP1] = useState(0.5);
  const [p2, setP2] = useState(0.3);
  const p3 = Math.max(0, 1 - p1 - p2);
  const ps = [p1, p2, p3];
  const terms = ps.map((p) => (p <= 1e-12 ? 0 : -p * Math.log2(p)));
  const H = terms.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const isUniform = Math.abs(p1 - 1 / 3) < 0.005 && Math.abs(p2 - 1 / 3) < 0.005;
  const gap = LOG2_3 - H;

  const setP1c = (v: number) => {
    setP1(v);
    if (v + p2 > 1) setP2(Math.max(0, 1 - v));
  };
  const setP2c = (v: number) => {
    setP2(v);
    if (v + p1 > 1) setP1(Math.max(0, 1 - v));
  };

  const PW = 340;
  const BH = 150;
  const barX = [60, 170, 280];
  const scale = 110; // px per unit probability
  const uniY = BH - 20 - (1 / 3) * scale;

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[290px_1fr]">
      {/* controls */}
      <div className="space-y-1 rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-3">
        <p className="mb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
          3-outcome distribution (p₃ is automatic)
        </p>
        <SliderRow label="p₁" value={p1} min={0} max={1} onChange={setP1c} accent="#8b5cf6" />
        <SliderRow label="p₂" value={p2} min={0} max={1} onChange={setP2c} accent="#8b5cf6" />
        <div className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-3">
          <span className="w-24 shrink-0 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">p₃ = 1−p₁−p₂</span>
          <div className="h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full bg-muted" />
          <span className="w-14 shrink-0 text-right font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">{f4(p3)}</span>
        </div>
        <WidgetControls className="mt-2 justify-center bg-transparent p-0">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="h-11" onClick={() => { setP1(0.5); setP2(0.3); }}>
            Notes preset [0.5, 0.3, 0.2]
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="h-11" onClick={() => { setP1(1 / 3); setP2(1 / 3); }}>
            Uniform [1/3, 1/3, 1/3]
          </Button>
        </WidgetControls>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-2">
          <Stat label="H(p) — current" value={`${f4(H)} bits`} tone={isUniform ? "good" : "default"} />
          <Stat label="H(uniform) = log₂3" value={`${f4(LOG2_3)} bits`} tone="accent" />
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-lg bg-background p-2.5">
          <p className="break-words font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            H = −( {f4(p1)}·log₂{f4(p1)} + {f4(p2)}·log₂{f4(p2)} + {f4(p3)}·log₂{f4(p3)} )
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 break-words font-mono text-[11px] text-foreground">
            = {f4(terms[0])} + {f4(terms[1])} + {f4(terms[2])} = {f4(H)} bits
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* chart */}
      <div className="min-w-0 space-y-3">
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
          <div className="mb-1 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
              The distribution p = [p₁, p₂, p₃]
            </p>
            {isUniform ? (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" /> at maximum entropy
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                uniform is always max entropy
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${PW} ${BH}`} className="h-auto w-full" role="img" aria-label="Probability bars">
            <line x1={40} y1={BH - 20} x2={PW - 10} y2={BH - 20} className="stroke-border" strokeWidth={1.5} />
            {/* uniform reference */}
            <line x1={40} y1={uniY} x2={PW - 10} y2={uniY} className="stroke-muted-foreground" strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="5 4" strokeOpacity={0.7} />
            <text x={PW - 12} y={uniY - 4} textAnchor="end" fontSize={9.5} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
              uniform 1/3
            </text>
            {ps.map((p, i) => (
              <g key={i}>
                <rect
                  x={barX[i]}
                  y={BH - 20 - p * scale}
                  width={50}
                  height={Math.max(1, p * scale)}
                  rx={5}
                  className="fill-primary"
                  fillOpacity={0.8}
                />
                <text x={barX[i] + 25} y={BH - 26 - p * scale} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={10.5} className="fill-foreground font-mono">
                  {f4(p)}
                </text>
                <text x={barX[i] + 25} y={BH - 6} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={10.5} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
                  p{i + 1}
                </text>
              </g>
            ))}
          </svg>
        </div>

        {/* entropy meter */}
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
          <div className="mb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
            <span>Entropy meter</span>
            <span className="font-mono normal-case">gap to max: {f4(Math.max(0, gap))} bits</span>
          </div>
          <div className="relative h-6 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
            <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-primary/70 transition-all" style={{ width: `${(H / LOG2_3) * 100}%` }} />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 flex justify-between font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
            <span>0</span>
            <span>H(p) = {f4(H)}</span>
            <span>max = log₂3 = {f4(LOG2_3)}</span>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            H(p) = 1.4855 &lt; H(uniform) = 1.5850 for the notes&rsquo; example [0.5, 0.3, 0.2]: any deviation from
            uniform — like favouring one outcome — reduces entropy. With no information beyond normalisation, spreading
            probability equally (pᵢ = 1/n) is the least-biased choice, provable with a single Lagrange multiplier.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* TAB B — Continuous: fixed mean & variance => Gaussian              */
/* ================================================================== */

const SQ3 = Math.sqrt(3);
const SQ2 = Math.sqrt(2);

function ContinuousTab() {
  const [mu, setMu] = useState(0);
  const [sg, setSg] = useState(1);

  const gauss = (x: number) => Math.exp(-((x - mu) ** 2) / (2 * sg * sg)) / (sg * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));
  const unif = (x: number) => {
    const half = SQ3 * sg;
    return x >= mu - half && x <= mu + half ? 1 / (2 * half) : 0;
  };
  const b = sg / SQ2;
  const laplace = (x: number) => Math.exp(-Math.abs(x - mu) / b) / (2 * b);

  const hGaussAnalytic = 0.5 * Math.log(2 * Math.PI * Math.E * sg * sg);
  const hGaussNum = numEntropy(gauss, mu - 10 * sg, mu + 10 * sg);
  const hUnif = numEntropy(unif, mu - SQ3 * sg - 1e-9, mu + SQ3 * sg + 1e-9);
  const hLap = numEntropy(laplace, mu - 12 * b, mu + 12 * b);

  /* density plot */
  const PW = 460;
  const PH = 150;
  const lo = mu - 4.2 * sg - 0.8;
  const hi = mu + 4.2 * sg + 0.8;
  const ymax = Math.max(gauss(mu), unif(mu), laplace(mu)) * 1.12;
  const sx = (x: number) => ((x - lo) / (hi - lo)) * PW;
  const sy = (y: number) => PH - (Math.min(y, ymax) / ymax) * (PH - 8) - 4;
  const pathOf = (f: (x: number) => number) => {
    const pts: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 200; i++) {
      const x = lo + ((hi - lo) * i) / 200;
      pts.push(`${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${sx(x).toFixed(1)},${sy(f(x)).toFixed(1)}`);
    }
    return pts.join(" ");
  };

  /* entropy vs sigma mini plot */
  const SW = 460;
  const SH = 110;
  const sgLo = 0.2;
  const sgHi = 2.5;
  const hMax = 0.5 * Math.log(2 * Math.PI * Math.E * sgHi * sgHi); // largest value on axis
  const hx = (s: number) => ((s - sgLo) / (sgHi - sgLo)) * SW;
  const hy = (h: number) => SH - (h / hMax) * (SH - 10) - 5;
  const hPath = (f: (s: number) => number) => {
    const pts: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 120; i++) {
      const s = sgLo + ((sgHi - sgLo) * i) / 120;
      pts.push(`${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${hx(s).toFixed(1)},${hy(f(s)).toFixed(1)}`);
    }
    return pts.join(" ");
  };

  const rows = [
    { name: "Gaussian N(μ, σ²)", color: "#8b5cf6", h: hGaussNum, formula: "h = ½·ln(2πeσ²)", max: true },
    { name: "Laplace(μ, σ/√2)", color: "#f59e0b", h: hLap, formula: "same variance 2b² = σ²", max: false },
    { name: `Uniform[μ−√3σ, μ+√3σ]`, color: "#38bdf8", h: hUnif, formula: "same variance (2√3σ)²/12 = σ²", max: false },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[290px_1fr]">
      {/* controls */}
      <div className="space-y-1 rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-3">
        <p className="mb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
          Fixed constraints: mean μ and variance σ²
        </p>
        <SliderRow label="μ" value={mu} min={-2} max={2} onChange={setMu} accent="#8b5cf6" />
        <SliderRow label="σ" value={sg} min={0.3} max={2} onChange={setSg} accent="#8b5cf6" />
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-2">
          <Stat label="Gaussian h (analytic)" value={`${f4(hGaussAnalytic)} nats`} tone="accent" />
          <Stat label="Gaussian h (numeric)" value={`${f4(hGaussNum)} nats`} tone="good" />
        </div>
        <p className="pt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
          Entropies of the alternatives are computed by numeric integration, h = −∫ p ln p dx — they always come out
          below the Gaussian with the same mean and variance.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="min-w-0 space-y-3">
        {/* density plot */}
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
          <div className="mb-1 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
              Three distributions, identical mean μ = {f2(mu)} and variance σ² = {f4(sg * sg)}
            </p>
            <div className="flex gap-3 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm" style={{ backgroundColor: "#8b5cf6" }} /> Gaussian
              </span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm" style={{ backgroundColor: "#f59e0b" }} /> Laplace
              </span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm" style={{ backgroundColor: "#38bdf8" }} /> Uniform
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${PW} ${PH + 16}`} className="h-auto w-full" role="img" aria-label="Densities with same mean and variance">
            <line x1={0} y1={PH - 4} x2={PW} y2={PH - 4} className="stroke-border" strokeWidth={1.2} />
            <path d={pathOf(unif)} fill="none" stroke="#38bdf8" strokeWidth={2} />
            <path d={pathOf(laplace)} fill="none" stroke="#f59e0b" strokeWidth={2} />
            <path d={pathOf(gauss)} fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" strokeWidth={2.4} />
            <line x1={sx(mu)} y1={6} x2={sx(mu)} y2={PH - 4} stroke="currentColor" strokeOpacity={0.3} strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="2 3" />
            <text x={sx(mu)} y={PH + 11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={9.5} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
              μ
            </text>
          </svg>
        </div>

        {/* entropy bars */}
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
          <p className="mb-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
            Differential entropy h (nats) — Gaussian wins every time
          </p>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {rows.map((r) => (
              <div key={r.name} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="w-44 shrink-0 truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground" title={r.formula}>
                  {r.name}
                </span>
                <div className="h-5 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-md bg-muted">
                  <div
                    className="flex h-full items-center justify-end rounded-md pr-1.5 transition-all"
                    style={{ width: `${(r.h / hMax) * 100}%`, backgroundColor: r.color, opacity: r.max ? 1 : 0.55 }}
                  >
                    <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-bold text-white">{f4(r.h)}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {r.max && (
                  <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                    max
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            The Gaussian has maximum entropy among <em>all</em> distributions with fixed mean &amp; variance — that is why
            it is everywhere (including the VAE prior p(z) = N(0, I)). Maximising −∫p ln p dx under the three constraints
            (normalisation, mean, variance) with Lagrange multipliers yields exactly the exponential-family form
            p(x) ∝ exp(λ₁x + λ₂(x−μ)²) — the Normal distribution.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* entropy vs sigma */}
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
          <p className="mb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
            Entropy grows with σ (h in nats) — current σ = {f2(sg)} marked
          </p>
          <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${SW} ${SH + 16}`} className="h-auto w-full" role="img" aria-label="Entropy versus sigma">
            <line x1={0} y1={SH - 5} x2={SW} y2={SH - 5} className="stroke-border" strokeWidth={1.2} />
            <path d={hPath((s) => 0.5 * Math.log(2 * Math.PI * Math.E * s * s))} fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" strokeWidth={2.2} />
            <path d={hPath((s) => 1 + Math.log(SQ2 * s))} fill="none" stroke="#f59e0b" strokeWidth={1.8} />
            <path d={hPath((s) => Math.log(2 * SQ3 * s))} fill="none" stroke="#38bdf8" strokeWidth={1.8} />
            <line x1={hx(sg)} y1={4} x2={hx(sg)} y2={SH - 5} stroke="currentColor" strokeOpacity={0.4} strokeWidth={1.5} strokeDasharray="3 3" />
            <circle cx={hx(sg)} cy={hy(hGaussAnalytic)} r={4} fill="#8b5cf6" stroke="currentColor" strokeOpacity={0.3} />
            <text x={hx(sg) + 5} y={hy(hGaussAnalytic) - 6} fontSize={9.5} className="fill-foreground font-mono">
              {f4(hGaussAnalytic)}
            </text>
            <text x={2} y={SH + 11} fontSize={9.5} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
              σ = 0.2
            </text>
            <text x={SW - 2} y={SH + 11} textAnchor="end" fontSize={9.5} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
              σ = 2.5
            </text>
          </svg>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ================================================================== */

export default function Component({ title, description }: { title?: string; description?: string }) {
  return (
    <WidgetFrame
      title={title ?? "Maximum Entropy Lab"}
      description={description ?? "Jaynes' principle: given only partial information, choose the least-biased distribution consistent with it."}
      accent="u4"
    >
      <Tabs defaultValue="discrete">
        <TabsList className="h-11 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <TabsTrigger value="discrete" className="px-4">
            <BarChart3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Discrete
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="continuous" className="px-4">
            <Waves className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Continuous → Gaussian
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>
        <TabsContent value="discrete" className="mt-3">
          <DiscreteTab />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="continuous" className="mt-3">
          <ContinuousTab />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </WidgetFrame>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { WidgetFrame, Stat, WidgetControls, PlayButton } from "./frame";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { Slider } from "@/components/ui/slider";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { AlertTriangle, Calculator, Crosshair, Gamepad2, RotateCcw, Scale } from "lucide-react";

/* ---------------- helpers ---------------- */

const ln = Math.log;
const f2 = (x: number) => {
  const s = x.toFixed(2);
  return s === "-0.00" ? "0.00" : s;
};
const f4 = (x: number) => {
  const s = x.toFixed(4);
  return s === "-0.0000" ? "0.0000" : s;
};

function mulberry32(seed: number) {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a |= 0;
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
function randn(rng: () => number) {
  const u = Math.max(1e-9, rng());
  return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * rng());
}

const pdf = (x: number, m: number, s: number) => Math.exp(-((x - m) ** 2) / (2 * s * s)) / (s * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));

function SliderRow({
  label,
  value,
  min,
  max,
  step = 0.01,
  onChange,
  accent,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  step?: number;
  onChange: (v: number) => void;
  accent?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-3">
      <span className="w-24 shrink-0 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
      <Slider value={[value]} min={min} max={max} step={step} onValueChange={(v) => onChange(v[0])} className="h-11 flex-1" aria-label={label} />
      <span className="w-14 shrink-0 text-right font-mono text-xs font-semibold" style={{ color: accent }}>
        {f2(value)}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

/* TAB A — Loss calculator (notes Example 4.1)                        */

function LossTab() {
  const [dx, setDx] = useState(0.7);
  const [dg, setDg] = useState(0.4);

  const lnx = ln(dx);
  const ln1mg = ln(1 - dg);
  const ld = -(lnx + ln1mg);
  const lg = -ln(dg);

  const gradOrig = 1 / (1 - 0.2);
  const gradNonSat = 1 / 0.2;

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[290px_1fr]">
      <div className="space-y-1 rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-3">
        <p className="mb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
          Discriminator readouts (one real + one fake sample)
        </p>
        <SliderRow label="D(x)" value={dx} min={0.01} max={0.99} onChange={setDx} accent="#10b981" />
        <SliderRow label="D(G(z))" value={dg} min={0.01} max={0.99} onChange={setDg} accent="#f43f5e" />
        <div className="space-y-2 pt-2">
          <div>
            <p className="mb-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">D on the real sample</p>
            <div className="h-3 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
              <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-emerald-500 transition-all" style={{ width: `${dx * 100}%` }} />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <p className="mb-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">D on the fake sample</p>
            <div className="h-3 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
              <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-rose-500 transition-all" style={{ width: `${dg * 100}%` }} />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="mt-2 h-9 w-full text-xs" onClick={() => { setDx(0.7); setDg(0.4); }}>
          Reset to notes values (0.7, 0.4)
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="min-w-0 space-y-3">
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-3">
            <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
              <Scale className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Discriminator loss (D wants this LOW)
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2 break-words font-mono text-xs text-foreground">
              L<sub>D</sub> = −[ log D(x) + log(1−D(G(z))) ]
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 break-words font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              = −[ ({f4(lnx)}) + ({f4(ln1mg)}) ]
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2 font-mono text-lg font-bold text-foreground">{f4(ld)}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-3">
            <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
              <Scale className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Generator loss, non-saturating (G wants this LOW)
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2 break-words font-mono text-xs text-foreground">L<sub>G</sub> = − log D(G(z))</p>
            <p className="mt-1 break-words font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">= −({f4(ln(dg))})</p>
            <p className="mt-2 font-mono text-lg font-bold text-foreground">{f4(lg)}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Stat label="log D(x) — D's confidence on real" value={f4(lnx)} tone="default" />
          <Stat label="log(1−D(G(z))) — D's confidence fake is fake" value={f4(ln1mg)} tone="default" />
        </div>

        {/* vanishing gradient note */}
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 p-3">
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Why the non-saturating loss? Gradient check at s = D(G(z)) = 0.2
          </p>
          <div className="mt-2 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="rounded-lg bg-background p-2.5">
              <p className="font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Original: d/ds log(1−s) = −1/(1−s)</p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">|−1/0.8| = {f2(gradOrig)}</p>
              <div className="mt-1.5 h-2.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
                <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/60" style={{ width: `${(gradOrig / gradNonSat) * 100}%` }} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-lg bg-background p-2.5">
              <p className="font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Non-saturating: d/ds (−log s) = −1/s</p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">|−1/0.2| = {f2(gradNonSat)}</p>
              <div className="mt-1.5 h-2.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
                <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-primary" style={{ width: "100%" }} />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            The non-saturating gradient ({f2(gradNonSat)}) is 4× larger in magnitude exactly when G is performing badly —
            it gives a much stronger learning signal precisely when G needs it most. That is why in practice G is trained
            to maximise log D(G(z)) instead of minimising log(1−D(G(z))).
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* TAB B — Optimal discriminator D*(x)                                */

const B_LO = -1;
const B_HI = 7;
const B_N = 200;

function OptimalTab() {
  const [muG, setMuG] = useState(1.2);
  const [sgG, setSgG] = useState(1.0);

  const pd = (x: number) => pdf(x, 3, 1);
  const pg = (x: number) => pdf(x, muG, sgG);
  const dstar = (x: number) => {
    const a = pd(x);
    const b = pg(x);
    return a + b < 1e-12 ? 0.5 : a / (a + b);
  };

  let maxDev = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
    const x = B_LO + ((B_HI - B_LO) * i) / 100;
    maxDev = Math.max(maxDev, Math.abs(dstar(x) - 0.5));
  }
  const atEquilibrium = maxDev < 0.05;

  const ymax = Math.max(0.45, 1 / (sgG * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI)), pd(3));

  const PW = 460;
  const DH = 130; // density plot height
  const SH = 78; // D* plot height
  const sx = (x: number) => ((x - B_LO) / (B_HI - B_LO)) * PW;
  const dy = (y: number) => DH - Math.min(1, y / ymax) * (DH - 8) - 4;
  const sy = (d: number) => SH - d * (SH - 10) - 5;

  const path = (f: (x: number) => number) => {
    const pts: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= B_N; i++) {
      const x = B_LO + ((B_HI - B_LO) * i) / B_N;
      pts.push(`${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${sx(x).toFixed(1)},${dy(f(x)).toFixed(1)}`);
    }
    return pts.join(" ");
  };
  const dPath = () => {
    const pts: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= B_N; i++) {
      const x = B_LO + ((B_HI - B_LO) * i) / B_N;
      pts.push(`${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${sx(x).toFixed(1)},${sy(dstar(x)).toFixed(1)}`);
    }
    return pts.join(" ");
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[290px_1fr]">
      <div className="space-y-1 rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-3">
        <p className="mb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
          Generator distribution p_g(x)
        </p>
        <SliderRow label="μ_g" value={muG} min={0} max={6} onChange={setMuG} accent="#f43f5e" />
        <SliderRow label="σ_g" value={sgG} min={0.5} max={2} onChange={setSgG} accent="#f43f5e" />
        <p className="pt-1 font-mono text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">p_data(x) = N(3, 1) — fixed</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-2">
          <Stat label="max |D* − 0.5|" value={f4(maxDev)} tone={atEquilibrium ? "good" : "default"} />
          <Stat label="D*(μ_g)" value={f4(dstar(muG))} tone="accent" />
        </div>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="mt-2 h-9 w-full text-xs" onClick={() => { setMuG(1.2); setSgG(1.0); }}>
          Reset (μ_g = 1.2, σ_g = 1.0)
        </Button>
        <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-background p-2.5">
          <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">Derivation:</span> for fixed x, V(D,G) contains
            f(y) = a·log y + b·log(1−y) with a = p_data(x), b = p_g(x). Setting df/dy = 0 gives y = a/(a+b):
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1.5 break-words font-mono text-xs text-foreground">D*(x) = p_data / (p_data + p_g)</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="min-w-0 space-y-3">
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
          <div className="mb-1 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
              The two distributions
            </p>
            <div className="flex gap-3 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm bg-emerald-500" /> p_data
              </span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm bg-rose-500" /> p_g
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${PW} ${DH + 18}`} className="h-auto w-full" role="img" aria-label="Data and generator distributions">
            <line x1={0} y1={DH - 4} x2={PW} y2={DH - 4} className="stroke-border" strokeWidth={1.2} />
            <path d={path(pg)} fill="none" stroke="#f43f5e" strokeWidth={2.2} />
            <path d={path(pd)} fill="none" stroke="#10b981" strokeWidth={2.2} strokeDasharray="6 3" />
            <line x1={sx(3)} y1={10} x2={sx(3)} y2={DH - 4} stroke="#10b981" strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="2 3" strokeOpacity={0.6} />
            <line x1={sx(muG)} y1={10} x2={sx(muG)} y2={DH - 4} stroke="#f43f5e" strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="2 3" strokeOpacity={0.6} />
            <text x={sx(3)} y={DH + 12} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={9.5} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
              3
            </text>
            <text x={sx(muG)} y={DH + 12} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={9.5} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
              μ_g
            </text>
          </svg>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
          <div className="mb-1 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
              Optimal discriminator D*(x) = p_data/(p_data + p_g)
            </p>
            {atEquilibrium && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                <Crosshair className="h-3 w-3" /> Nash equilibrium: D can only guess a coin flip
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${PW} ${SH + 18}`} className="h-auto w-full" role="img" aria-label="Optimal discriminator curve">
            {/* region where D* < 0.5 — where fakes get caught */}
            {Array.from({ length: B_N }, (_, i) => {
              const x0 = B_LO + ((B_HI - B_LO) * i) / B_N;
              const d = dstar(x0);
              if (d >= 0.5) return null;
              return (
                <rect
                  key={i}
                  x={sx(x0)}
                  y={sy(0.5)}
                  width={PW / B_N + 0.6}
                  height={sy(d) - sy(0.5)}
                  fill="#f43f5e"
                  fillOpacity={0.12}
                />
              );
            })}
            <line x1={0} y1={sy(1)} x2={PW} y2={sy(1)} className="stroke-border" strokeWidth={1} />
            <line x1={0} y1={sy(0.5)} x2={PW} y2={sy(0.5)} className="stroke-muted-foreground" strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="4 4" strokeOpacity={0.6} />
            <line x1={0} y1={sy(0)} x2={PW} y2={sy(0)} className="stroke-border" strokeWidth={1.2} />
            <path d={dPath()} fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" strokeWidth={2.4} />
            <text x={4} y={sy(1) - 3} fontSize={9} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
              1.0
            </text>
            <text x={4} y={sy(0.5) - 3} fontSize={9} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
              0.5
            </text>
            <text x={4} y={sy(0) - 3} fontSize={9} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
              0.0
            </text>
            {/* G's update direction */}
            <line
              x1={sx(muG)}
              y1={sy(dstar(muG)) - 8}
              x2={sx(muG + 0.85)}
              y2={sy(dstar(muG)) - 8}
              stroke="#f43f5e"
              strokeWidth={2}
              markerEnd="url(#gan-arrow-b)"
            />
            <text x={sx(muG) + 4} y={sy(dstar(muG)) - 14} fontSize={9.5} className="fill-rose-600 dark:fill-rose-400 font-mono">
              G moves this way
            </text>
            <defs>
              <marker id="gan-arrow-b" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="6" refY="4" orient="auto">
                <path d="M0,0 L8,4 L0,8 z" fill="#f43f5e" />
              </marker>
            </defs>
          </svg>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">What G sees:</span> in the rose region D*(x) &lt; 0.5, so
            generated samples there get labelled &ldquo;fake&rdquo;. G&rsquo;s gradient pushes p_g toward the data until
            the rose region vanishes — at p_g = p_data, D* = 0.5 everywhere and the best possible discriminator can do no
            better than a coin flip.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ================================================================== */
/* TAB C — Training game (simulated 1-D GAN)                          */
/* ================================================================== */

type GameRound = { round: number; ld: number; lg: number };

function GameTab() {
  const [round, setRound] = useState(0);
  const [muG, setMuG] = useState(0.6);
  const [sgG, setSgG] = useState(0.9);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<GameRound[]>([]);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [collapse, setCollapse] = useState(false);

  const real = useMemo(() => {
    const rng = mulberry32(99);
    return Array.from({ length: 36 }, () => 3 + randn(rng));
  }, []);

  const fakes = useMemo(() => {
    const rng = mulberry32(5000 + round * 977);
    return Array.from({ length: 24 }, () => muG + sgG * randn(rng));
  }, [round, muG, sgG]);

  const pd = (x: number) => pdf(x, 3, 1);
  const pg = (x: number) => pdf(x, muG, sgG);
  const dstar = (x: number) => {
    const a = pd(x);
    const b = pg(x);
    return a + b < 1e-12 ? 0.5 : a / (a + b);
  };

  const ld = (() => {
    const d = (x: number) => {
      const a = pd(x);
      const b = pg(x);
      return a + b < 1e-12 ? 0.5 : a / (a + b);
    };
    const mReal = real.reduce((s, x) => s + ln(Math.max(1e-9, d(x))), 0) / real.length;
    const mFake = fakes.reduce((s, x) => s + ln(Math.max(1e-9, 1 - d(x))), 0) / fakes.length;
    return -(mReal + mFake);
  })();
  const lg = (() => {
    const d = (x: number) => {
      const a = pd(x);
      const b = pg(x);
      return a + b < 1e-12 ? 0.5 : a / (a + b);
    };
    return -fakes.reduce((s, x) => s + ln(Math.max(1e-9, d(x))), 0) / fakes.length;
  })();

  const stepRound = () => {
    const rng = mulberry32(7000 + round * 131);
    let nMu = muG + 0.16 * (3 - muG) + 0.05 * randn(rng);
    let nSg = sgG;
    if (collapse) {
      nSg = Math.max(0.1, sgG * 0.8);
      nMu += 0.09 * (2.35 - muG); // drift to a single point that still partly fools D
    }
    nMu = Math.max(-0.5, Math.min(6, nMu));
    setMuG(nMu);
    setSgG(nSg);
    setRound((r) => r + 1);
    setHistory((h) => [...h.slice(-59), { round: round + 1, ld, lg }]);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return;
    const id = window.setInterval(stepRound, 480);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  });

  const reset = () => {
    setPlaying(false);
    setRound(0);
    setMuG(0.6);
    setSgG(0.9);
    setHistory([]);
  };

  /* plot geometry */
  const PW = 460;
  const PH = 250;
  const C_LO = -1.5;
  const C_HI = 7.5;
  const sx = (x: number) => ((x - C_LO) / (C_HI - C_LO)) * PW;
  const dyOf = (d: number) => 26 + (1 - d) * 86; // D curve band: y 26..112
  const dPath = () => {
    const pts: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 160; i++) {
      const x = C_LO + ((C_HI - C_LO) * i) / 160;
      pts.push(`${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${sx(x).toFixed(1)},${dyOf(dstar(x)).toFixed(1)}`);
    }
    return pts.join(" ");
  };
  const fakeRng = mulberry32(5000 + round * 977); // same seed as fakes → same jitter
  const fakeJit = fakes.map((_, i) => (fakeRng() - 0.5) * 30);
  const realRng = mulberry32(99 + 1);
  const realJit = real.map(() => 135 + (realRng() - 0.5) * 80);

  const sparkW = 220;
  const sparkH = 54;
  const spark = (key: "ld" | "lg") => {
    const pts = history.slice(-40);
    if (pts.length < 2) return "";
    const maxV = 3;
    return pts
      .map((p, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${((i / (pts.length - 1)) * sparkW).toFixed(1)},${(sparkH - (Math.min(maxV, p[key]) / maxV) * (sparkH - 6) - 3).toFixed(1)}`)
      .join(" ");
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <WidgetControls>
        <div className="flex min-h-11 items-center">
          <PlayButton playing={playing} label="Train GAN" onClick={() => setPlaying((p) => !p)} />
        </div>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="h-11" onClick={stepRound} disabled={playing}>
          Step 1 round
        </Button>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="h-11" onClick={reset}>
          <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Reset
        </Button>
        <div className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-background px-3">
          <Switch checked={collapse} onCheckedChange={setCollapse} aria-label="Toggle mode collapse" />
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">Mode collapse</span>
        </div>
        <div className="ml-auto flex gap-2">
          <Stat label="Round" value={round} />
          <Stat label="μ_G" value={f2(muG)} />
          <Stat label="σ_G" value={f2(sgG)} tone={collapse ? "bad" : "default"} />
          <Stat label="L_D" value={f4(ld)} />
          <Stat label="L_G" value={f4(Math.min(lg, 99))} tone="accent" />
        </div>
      </WidgetControls>

      <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_250px]">
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
          <p className="mb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
            Real dots vs generated dots, with D*(x) responding every round
          </p>
          <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${PW} ${PH}`} className="h-auto w-full" role="img" aria-label="GAN training game">
            {/* D curve band */}
            <line x1={0} y1={dyOf(1)} x2={PW} y2={dyOf(1)} className="stroke-border" strokeWidth={1} />
            <line x1={0} y1={dyOf(0.5)} x2={PW} y2={dyOf(0.5)} className="stroke-muted-foreground" strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="4 4" strokeOpacity={0.5} />
            <path d={dPath()} fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" strokeWidth={2.2} />
            <text x={4} y={dyOf(1) + 11} fontSize={9} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
              D*(x)
            </text>
            <text x={4} y={dyOf(0.5) - 4} fontSize={9} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
              0.5
            </text>
            {/* data band divider */}
            <line x1={0} y1={122} x2={PW} y2={122} className="stroke-border" strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="2 4" />
            {/* real samples */}
            {real.map((x, i) => (
              <circle key={`r${i}`} cx={sx(x)} cy={realJit[i] + 55} r={2.6} fill="#10b981" fillOpacity={0.75} />
            ))}
            {/* fake samples */}
            {fakes.map((x, i) => (
              <circle key={`f${i}`} cx={sx(x)} cy={190 + fakeJit[i] * 0.9} r={3} fill="#f43f5e" fillOpacity={0.8} />
            ))}
            {/* mean markers */}
            <path d={`M${sx(3)},${240} l-5,9 l10,0 z`} fill="#10b981" />
            <path d={`M${sx(muG)},${240} l-5,9 l10,0 z`} fill="#f43f5e" />
            <text x={sx(3)} y={236} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={9} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
              μ_data=3
            </text>
            <text x={sx(muG)} y={236} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={9} className="fill-muted-foreground font-mono">
              μ_G
            </text>
          </svg>
          <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-3 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm bg-emerald-500" /> real x ~ N(3, 1)
            </span>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm bg-rose-500" /> fakes G(z) ~ N(μ_G, σ_G)
            </span>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm" style={{ backgroundColor: "#8b5cf6" }} /> D*(x)
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            Each round: G takes a gradient step (μ_G drifts toward the data 3), then D&rsquo;s optimal curve updates. Watch
            L<sub>D</sub> rise toward ln 4 ≈ 1.386 and L<sub>G</sub> toward ln 2 ≈ 0.693 as the game reaches its Nash
            equilibrium — exactly where D* flattens to 0.5.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
            <p className="mb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
              Loss history (last 40 rounds)
            </p>
            <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${sparkW} ${sparkH}`} className="h-auto w-full" role="img" aria-label="Loss history">
              <line x1={0} y1={sparkH - 3 - (1.386 / 3) * (sparkH - 6)} x2={sparkW} y2={sparkH - 3 - (1.386 / 3) * (sparkH - 6)} className="stroke-emerald-500" strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="3 3" strokeOpacity={0.6} />
              <path d={spark("lg")} fill="none" stroke="#f43f5e" strokeWidth={1.8} />
              <path d={spark("ld")} fill="none" stroke="#10b981" strokeWidth={1.8} />
            </svg>
            <div className="mt-1 flex gap-3 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm bg-emerald-500" /> L_D
              </span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm bg-rose-500" /> L_G
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {collapse ? (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/5 p-3">
              <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">
                <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Mode collapse is happening
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                G discovered a narrow band of outputs that partly fools D and collapsed onto it: σ_G → 0.1, so every
                sample is nearly identical. The samples look individually plausible but are highly repetitive — the
                diversity of p_data is lost. Remedies: mini-batch discrimination, unrolled GANs, Wasserstein GAN (WGAN)
                with gradient penalty, feature matching.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-3">
              <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                <Gamepad2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> The game so far
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                Early on, D confidently separates the two dot clouds (sharp D* curve, low L_D, high L_G). As G improves,
                D&rsquo;s edge melts away. Because this is a minimax game — not a single loss being minimised — training
                can also oscillate rather than converge (training instability).
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ================================================================== */

export default function Component({ title, description }: { title?: string; description?: string }) {
  return (
    <WidgetFrame
      title={title ?? "GAN Lab"}
      description={description ?? "Two players, one minimax game: D learns to tell real from fake, G learns to fool D — no labels required."}
      accent="u4"
    >
      <Tabs defaultValue="loss">
        <TabsList className="h-11 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <TabsTrigger value="loss" className="px-3">
            <Calculator className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Loss calculator
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="optimal" className="px-3">
            Optimal discriminator
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="game" className="px-3">
            <Gamepad2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Training game
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>
        <TabsContent value="loss" className="mt-3">
          <LossTab />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="optimal" className="mt-3">
          <OptimalTab />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="game" className="mt-3">
          <GameTab />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </WidgetFrame>
  );
}
